title: Chief Track – BID Position
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water \& Environment for public and private organizations.
   

  

 Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost\-effective and made\-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
   

  

 SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know\-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
   

  

 SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know\-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
   

  

 Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork \& Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling \& Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re\-modelling etc.
   

  

 Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
   

  

 Currently, we are bidding for Semi High Speed Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Track is the key position in these BIDs.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Technical Approval and Design Review: Lead the review and final approval of all permanent way designs, track alignments, geometry, and component specifications (rails, sleepers, fastenings) to ensure they meet the stringent high\-speed performance, safety, and operational standards.
* Quality Control and Construction Supervision: Establish and enforce rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) protocols for all track installation activities, including earthworks, ballast laying, welding, stressing, and geometry correction.
* Interface Management: Directly manage the technical interface between track works and other critical systems (e.g., Civil structures like bridges and tunnels, Signaling systems, and OHE/Power systems) to ensure seamless and safe integration.
* Ensure absolute compliance of the track system with national railway codes, international best practices, and project\-specific technical specifications to guarantee safety and long\-term maintainability.
* Develop and oversee the testing and commissioning strategy for the track, including the use of specialized track recording cars and geometry measurement equipment, to secure final certification for high\-speed operation.
* Provide expert technical guidance and direction to the main track contractors, resolving complex field issues, approving methodologies, and certifying progress payments based on verified quality and adherence to design.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Qualification: Graduate in Engineering or equivalent with working knowledge of reading, writing and speaking in English \[additional marks for PG in Engineering or equivalent]
* Minimum Experience: 20 years post minimum qualification in any Rail based Passenger Transit system \[additional marks for more experience in any Rail based Passenger Transit system\*]
* Relevant Experience: 10 years’ experience for Design or Installation of Ballast\-less Track system including Track Alignment for MRTS /Regional Rail /High Speed Rail as Chief Track Expert or equivalent position \[additional marks for more experience; experience in position one level below allowed with less weightage]
* Eligible Assignment\*\*(see below): Must have experience of 1 Eligible Assignment as Chief Track Expert or equivalent position for full\-time continuous deployment of not less than 2 years \[additional marks for more Eligible Assignments; less weightage for position one level below]
* International Experience: Minimum 3 years’ experience on projects for Rail based Passenger Transit system with operational speed of 160 kmph or more in Developed country(s) as defined in latest list of Developed countries as per Department of Economics and Social Affairs of the United Nations Secretariat (UN\-DESA)/World Bank – High Income Economies.
* Rail\-based Passenger Transit System shall mean
* High Speed Transit System / Regional Rail Transit System (with operational speed of 160kmh and above) OR
* Urban/Suburban/Intercity/Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS) \[excluding LRT with design PHPDT less than 20000/Tram/Monorail Systems]
* Shall mean experience of working as a personnel of General Consultant / Project Management Consultant / Employer’s Personnel in a work / project in a Rail based


 Passenger Transit System with operational speed of 160 kmph or more comprising:
   

  

* Construction of Civil structures (at\-grade/elevated/underground) AND
* Installation of Systems (Track, Rolling Stock, Traction \& Power Supply, Signalling)


 Including Detailed Design or Proof checking of designs; Bid Process Management; Project and Interface Management; Construction Supervision and System Installations and Testing \& Commissioning.
   

  

 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!

title: Production Supervisor CNC/VMC
description:
**Company Description** 
 Patlon Interlocks India Pvt. Ltd. traces its origins to 1972, when panel lock manufacturing began under the trade name Toyota Manufacturing Co. The business expanded into key interlocking systems and established Patlon Industries in 1983 in Lonavala. In April 2008, Patlon Industries was incorporated as Patlon Interlocks India Pvt. Ltd. Today, the company is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer and supplier of mechanical and electro\-mechanical safety interlocking systems, discharge rods, and isolator switch panels. Patlon Interlocks India Pvt. Ltd. is recognized for its focus on safety, quality, and reliable solutions for industrial applications.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Production Supervisor CNC/VMC is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Lonavala. This role oversees day\-to\-day CNC and VMC machining operations, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and safety guidelines are met. Responsibilities include managing operator teams, assigning tasks, monitoring machine performance, and resolving production issues. The Production Supervisor will coordinate production schedules, optimize resource utilization, track output, and maintain production records. The role also involves collaborating with quality, maintenance, and planning teams to support continuous improvement and timely delivery.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong supervisory skills, including team leadership and shop\-floor coordination.
* Ability to manage production schedules and handle production planning activities.
* Experience in production management within CNC/VMC machining environments.
* Effective communication skills for interacting with operators, engineers, and management.
* Hands\-on experience with CNC/VMC machines, tooling, and basic troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of quality standards, safety practices, and ISO 9001:2015 requirements.
* Diploma or degree in Mechanical/Production Engineering or a related discipline.
* Prior experience as a Production Supervisor or similar role in a manufacturing setting.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

**Job Description**
 Ares is seeking a highly motivated, detail\-oriented Associate Vice President to join the Fund Launch, Onboarding and Wind Down (“FLOW”) team and act as the business liaison to technology \[across multiple initiatives supporting the fund launch lifecycle for Private Credit, Real Estate, Private Equity, and Secondaries funds,]. In this role, the successful candidate will help bridge the gap between the business and technology by analyzing interconnected operational processes, documenting requirements, and supporting the full development lifecycle, including release testing and change management.
   

  

 This position is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting ideas, documenting and improving business processes, working with data, and solving problems creatively. The role focuses on implementing practical, high\-impact solutions that strengthen business operations across the firm.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is collaborative, agile, innovative, and proactive and must possess the ability to think critically and holistically while maintaining strong attention to detail.
   

  

**Process Improvements**
 PRIMARY FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES \-
   

  

* Collaborate with stakeholders across operational teams to understand workflows, identify team\-specific and intersectional opportunities for improvement, and translate requirements into development\-ready enhancements
* Bridge the gap between the business and technology to effectively execute on stakeholder\-driven system enhancements from documenting requirements through testing to final release
* Help to design, document and execute User Acceptance Test plans to validate enhancements as well as periodic regression testing to validate end\-to\-end business workflows, ensure functional requirements and performance standards and surface any defects post release
* Help to standardize processes and increase adoption through change management efforts, including by creating clear documentation for workflows, SOPs, and system processes, including maintaining an internal knowledge base and cross\-functional training, as requested


**Data, Reporting, AI**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and document key data related to their processes
* Analyze data sets across stakeholder workflows and systems to identify opportunities for standardization, including documenting stakeholder or related system data dictionaries, use cases and opportunities for unifying data initiatives to ensure data integrity
* Document reporting requirements and related data, including sourcing, ownership, definitions, and maintenance of knowledge base to ensure consistent data usage
* Work with stakeholders and technology to identify, document, and implement use cases for AI tools across systems, including automation, self\-service portals, data and reporting to increase efficiencies and speed to execution
* Provide support for data integration between systems, including analysis, audits and backfill projects, as needed


**Qualifications\-**
 Education: BS/BA with degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or General Business preferred, with outstanding academic record
   

  

**Experience And Skills Required**
* 7\+ years of relevant work experience in a business analyst or project management role, preferably within asset management
* Proven ability to effectively translate and document business and technology requirements and adjust communication style to fit the audience
* Strong problem\-solver with ability to identify and resolve issues before they become issues
* Self\-motivated and able to operate independently, proactively seeking clarity in ambiguous situations
* Highly adaptable and able to pivot quickly in response to changing priorities
* Analytical thinker with proven history of surfacing actionable insights to inform prioritization of process and data improvements across systems and enhancement requests
* Highly adaptable and able to reassess and pivot in response to quickly changing priorities
* Familiar with Agile, Scrum or other iterative product management style
* Able to leverage excellent interpersonal and inter\-cultural skills to drive execution and adoption of new systems and processes


**Strongly Preferred**

description:
Manager – Quality Audit (Order to Cash
   

  

**Job Title: Manager – Quality Audit (Order to Cash)**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Manager – Quality Audit to lead the Quality Management Framework for Order to Cash (OTC) operations across Billing, Cash Application, Collections, and Dispute Resolution. This role will be accountable for designing and sustaining a disciplined, repeatable, and data\-driven audit program that improves operational accuracy, strengthens internal controls, and connects quality outcomes to measurable business performance. The Manager will collaborate closely with vendor partners and cross\-functional stakeholders to define requirements, co\-build audit solutions, and drive successful deployment of audit workflows, risk\-based sampling, defect management, RCA/CAPA processes, and quality performance reporting across OTC operations. The role will also establish globally aligned audit standards, governance routines, and calibration practices to ensure consistency, transparency, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will combine strong OTC process expertise, audit and controls knowledge, leadership capability, and a proven ability to convert quality insights into sustained operational improvement and service excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Management Framework Leadership:** 
 Lead the end\-to\-end quality audit program for OTC processes and define enterprise standards for audit execution, governance, and continuous improvement across regions and teams.
   

  

**Audit Strategy \& Execution:** 
 Design and run transaction\-level audits across Billing, Cash Application, Collections, and Dispute Resolution using approved scorecards, evidence requirements, and quality dimensions such as SOP adherence, documentation, approvals, coding accuracy, outcome quality, and closure/completion.
   

  

**Sampling Methodology:** 
 Establish and maintain risk\-informed sampling methodologies by process and subprocess, with clear rules for ramp\-up, stabilization, and run\-rate operations; increase sample rates based on repeat defects, declining quality trends, new transitions, or elevated business risk.
   

  

**Error Taxonomy \& Calibration:** 
 Standardize critical and non\-critical error definitions, promote consistent scoring through calibration sessions, and resolve audit disputes through fact\-based review and governance escalation when needed.
   

  

**Defect Management, RCA \& CAPA:** 
 Own the defect management process, including centralized defect logging, trend analysis, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, containment, effectiveness validation, and closure discipline.
   

  

**Governance, Controls \& Compliance:** 
 Strengthen governance by ensuring adherence to internal controls, audit standards, SOX/statutory requirements, and approved operating procedures. Support control documentation, audit readiness, and remediation tracking in partnership with internal and external audit stakeholders.
   

  

**Performance Reporting \& Business Insight:** 
 Develop and socialize scorecards, dashboards, and management reporting that provide visibility to audit pass rates, defect trends, critical error rates, rework, first\-time\-right, process accuracy, CAPA closure, and links to business outcomes such as customer experience, revenue protection, working capital, and SLA performance.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management:** 
 Act as the primary quality contact for operations leaders, process owners, transition teams, and cross\-functional partners. Facilitate daily quality huddles, weekly calibrations, and monthly quality and operations reviews to drive issue resolution and decision\-making.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement \& Automation:** 
 Identify recurring pain points and conversion opportunities for SOP updates, job aids, training refresh, control redesign, and automation of sampling, audit execution, defect tracking, and reporting. Champion use of digital tools and analytics to improve audit efficiency and traceability.
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Capability Building:** 
 Recruit, coach, and develop quality analysts or auditors; set performance expectations; create capability plans; and build a prevention\-led quality culture that drives accountability, consistency, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Transition \& Stabilization Support:** 
 Provide quality oversight for migrations, scope expansions, and process changes by validating readiness criteria, reviewing documentation, increasing audit coverage where appropriate, and ensuring a controlled handoff to steady\-state operations.
   

  

**Customer and Business Outcome Focus:** 
 Ensure audit findings are translated into meaningful operational actions that reduce escalations, improve service quality, protect cash flow, reduce revenue leakage, and strengthen overall OTC health.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.
   

  

 8–10 years of progressive experience in Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, Finance Shared Services, Quality Audit, Controls, or Operational Excellence roles.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience across key OTC sub\-processes such as Billing, Cash Application, Collections, Dispute Resolution, and AR reporting or reconciliations. Working with
   

  

 3\+ years of people leadership or matrix leadership experience in a shared services, GBS, BPO, or complex operations environment.
   

  

 Experience designing or managing audit frameworks, scorecards, sampling plans, defect management, and RCA/CAPA processes.
   

  

 Strong familiarity with internal controls, SOX or compliance requirements, and process documentation standards.
   

  

**Certifications**
 Preferred: CPA, CA, CIA, CISA, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, Lean, or equivalent quality / audit certification. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), PMP, Quality Management certifications, or other finance controls / continuous improvement credentials.
   

  

**General Accountabilities And Job Information**
 This role typically operates in a global or regional shared services environment and may require collaboration across time zones and functional boundaries.
   

  

 Success in this role is measured through sustained improvements in audit accuracy, reduction in repeat defects and rework, stronger compliance adherence, improved governance effectiveness, and demonstrable impact to OTC business outcomes. Strong coaching and people\-development capability with a track record of building high\-performing, quality\-focused teams.

title: Lead, Client Service Operations
description:
Client Service Operations (CSO) enables Kroll's business units through operational excellence, standardized processes, and centralized support services. As part of CSO, the Business Support Services (BSS) function provides high\-quality business enablement services that enhance operational efficiency, improve consistency, strengthen governance, and elevate the internal stakeholder experience.
   

  

 Business Support Services operates as a centralized shared services organization supporting internal teams across a broad range of operational activities including business administration, sales support, document production, presentation services, workflow coordination, reporting, operational data management, and business process support. Through a customer\-centric approach and continuous improvement mindset, the team enables business units to focus on delivering value to clients.
   

  

 The Lead, Business Support Services is responsible for the day\-to\-day management and successful delivery of one or more Business Support Services offerings. The role provides operational leadership by ensuring service requests are delivered accurately, within agreed service levels, and in accordance with established quality standards. The Lead is accountable for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, monitoring operational performance, conducting quality reviews, and acting as the primary operational contact for assigned stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to ensuring consistent service delivery, the Lead is expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen governance, enhance team capability, and drive operational excellence across their service portfolio.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned Business Support Services offerings, ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels and quality expectations.
* Manage day\-to\-day operational activities, balancing workload, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Monitor work queues, request volumes, turnaround times, and service performance, taking proactive action to address delivery risks.
* Ensure business continuity through effective workload planning and resource management.
* Support transition of new services and operational activities into the Business Support Services operating model.
* Establish and maintain high standards of quality across all team deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews of complex or high\-risk deliverables and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Monitor quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement actions to reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.
* Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational controls, data handling requirements, and governance standards.
* Support audit requests and ensure operational documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to achieve operational and professional development objectives.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, individual capability, and team capacity.
* Monitor individual and team performance against established goals and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing capability development within the team.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer\-focused team culture.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned business stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and reliable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by providing regular updates on service requests, priorities, and operational performance.
* Resolve operational issues and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
* Support service reviews by providing updates on performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process standardization, simplification, and automation.
* Lead implementation of process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and stakeholder experience.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, knowledge articles, and operational guidance materials.
* Monitor operational metrics and identify trends to support informed decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the team.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams across Client Service Operations to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Work closely with leadership to support operational planning, resource management, and service expansion initiatives.
* Share best practices across Business Support Services to promote consistency and standardization.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Service Delivery: SLA achievement, Turnaround time, Queue management, Delivery throughput
* Quality: Quality scores, Rework rates, Process compliance, Audit readiness
* Operational Performance: Productivity, Capacity utilization, Workload balancing, Operational efficiency
* Stakeholder Experience: Stakeholder satisfaction, Escalation resolution, Responsiveness, Service adoption
* People: Team engagement, Performance management, Training completion, Capability development
* Continuous Improvement: Process improvements implemented, Standardization initiatives, Automation opportunities identified, Knowledge management contributions


**Essential Traits**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Management, or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in Client Service Operations, Shared Services, Business Operations, Business Support Services, or Professional Services.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading or coordinating operational teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing service delivery within a shared services or operational support environment.
* Strong operational leadership and service delivery management.
* Experience managing teams within a shared services or business operations environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience with workflow management, reporting, and operational governance.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Monday.com, SharePoint, ServiceNow, or similar workflow tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


**About Kroll**
 Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century\-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting\-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.
   

  

 In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com
   

  

*Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit*

title: Regional Operations Director
description:
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****About The Role****
 We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as an APAC Operations Director. This is a full\-time position based in India. This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and best in class service for Amazon in every country across its diverse businesses.
   

  

**Responsiblities**
 The APAC Operations Director will focus on six areas, working continuously with OpenDoor leaders to ensure success across each aspect for OpenDoor in APAC.
   

  

**Financial Operations**
* Own the APAC financial operations strategy, driving improvements in financial health, controls, accuracy, and process compliance across all markets.
* Establish governance frameworks and performance standards across billing, revenue recognition, PO management, commission reconciliation, and financial reporting processes.
* Partner with Global Commercial and FinOps teams to ensure consistent adoption of global standards, controls, and SOX requirements across APAC.
* Lead resolution of significant financial operational risks, trends, and recurring process failures.


**Process \& Continuous Improvement**
* Own the regional operational improvement roadmap, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate, and scale operational processes.
* Ensure operational processes remain fit for purpose and aligned to evolving business and client requirements.
* Sponsor cross\-functional initiatives that improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and strengthen governance.
* Act as the regional escalation point for complex operational challenges requiring structural or process change.


**Operational Excellence**
* Establish and monitor operational performance measures across APAC, including financial compliance, workflow adoption, PBR performance, and operational service quality.
* Lead regional operational reviews, ensuring actions, risks, and opportunities are actively managed and resolved.
* Drive accountability for adherence to agreed operational standards, policies, and ways of working.
* Provide operational performance reporting and insights to regional and global leadership teams.


**Project Management**
* Lead APAC participation in global transformation programmes, operational initiatives, and platform deployments.
* Prioritise and oversee regional operational projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate cross\-market delivery of operational change programmes and process improvements.
* Ensure project outcomes are effectively embedded into business\-as\-usual operations.


**Operating Model Effectiveness**
* Partner with market and regional leaders to identify capability gaps, onboarding requirements, and opportunities to improve operational maturity.
* Support implementation of consistent onboarding, role clarity, and operational standards across markets.
* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure Operations remains aligned to business needs while maintaining global consistency.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and develop the APAC Operations team, setting clear priorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Coach and support team members to build capability, drive accountability, and encourage continuous improvement.
* Allocate resources and workload to ensure effective delivery against regional and global priorities.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performing team culture focused on operational excellence and stakeholder partnership.


****Qualifications****
* Strong experience in media, business operations, financial operations, or operational leadership roles.
* Good understanding of media agency functions, delivery models, and financial processes.
* Proven track record of driving operational improvement, transformation, and organisational change.
* Experience implementing governance frameworks, controls, and performance management processes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge senior leaders.
* Excellent project and programme management capabilities.
* Outstanding communication, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

 Develop, implement, and maintain credit policies and procedures that minimize risk and promote revenue growth

 Lead and mentor a team of credit analysts and control team members, managing workloads, setting goals, and conducting performance reviews

 Oversee the assessment of credit risk, approve credit limits, and monitor credit exposures to ensure compliance with internal guidelines
* **Accounts Receivable Management:** 
 Ensure efficient management of accounts receivable and timely collection of monies owed. Implement strategies to reduce days sales outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with the sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and enhance customer satisfaction
* **Reporting and Compliance:** 
 Generate regular reports on credit control activities and performance metrics. Ensure compliance with financial policies and regulatory requirements

 Continuously identify and implement improvements in credit processes and technologies to increase efficiency and effectiveness

 Strong knowledge of credit\-related laws and regulations, as well as proficiency in financial software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel

 High level of analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess credit risk and make informed decisions

 Proven leadership skills with experience in managing teams. Ability to coach, mentor, and inspire team members to achieve business goals

 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization and external stakeholders

 Sales Strategy \& Planning

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, decision\-makers, and business partners to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.
* Negotiate rates, service terms, and offers in consultation with the Branch Head, ensuring adherence to pricing and profitability guidelines.

* Ensure timely collections and manage account receivables to meet financial targets and maintain healthy cash flow.

* 3\-5 years of experience in sales, marketing, or business development roles.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth and managing branch operations within the logistics or express delivery industry.
* Strong experience in developing and executing strategic sales plans, monitoring performance metrics, and achieving financial targets.

 Technical Skills:
   

  

  

* Proficiency in sales management techniques and strategies.
* Strong understanding of market analysis and competitive landscape.
* Experience with data analysis and reporting tools to monitor sales performance.
* Knowledge of logistics and express delivery industry practices.
* Ability to develop and implement effective marketing plans.


 Key Competencies:
   

  

  

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a high\-performing sales team.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for building customer relationships.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities to drive sales performance.

* Customer satisfaction score (NPS or similar metrics)
* % of customer complaints resolved within defined turnaround times

* % adherence to operational cost targets (OCPK and OCPM)
* % of on\-time deliveries

* Employee engagement scores within the sales team
* % of team members participating in training and development programs


 Market Expansion
   

  

  

* Number of new clients acquired in targeted segments
* % increase in market share for assigned product categories


 Compliance and Reporting
   

  

  

* Timeliness of sales reporting to senior management
* % adherence to compliance standards and internal policies


 Performance Management
   

  

  

* Adherence to performance management system timelines for sales staff

title: Manager, Payment Operations
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise\-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet\-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
 Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
 You’ll own the day\-to\-day Payment Operations function supporting Circle Payments Network, with accountability for operational coverage, queue performance, escalations, investigation quality, team capability, and process execution across a 24x7 environment. You’ll develop analysts from onboarding through independent case ownership, maintain a high bar for operational quality, and ensure the team has the processes, training, documentation, and performance management needed to operate effectively. You’ll also be the domain expert on the network and the senior operational escalation point for issues that cannot be resolved within the team.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Own shift design, rostering, coverage planning, and handoffs across a 24x7 model, including leave, surge and holiday planning, and the coverage math that sits behind it.
* Own live queue management, ensuring incoming partner queries and detected exceptions are picked up, triaged, worked, and closed within SLA.
* Own the escalation path. Senior Analysts are the first escalation point and work the hardest cases; you take what they cannot resolve and decide when an issue needs to leave the team and move to Engineering, Product, or partner\-facing leadership.
* Build and run analyst onboarding, continuous training, certification, and competency development, using actual case output to identify individual gaps, build targeted improvement plans, and develop analysts from day one through independent handling of the full query mix.
* Establish and operate the QC program, including case sampling, review, calibration, error taxonomy, investigation standards, and feedback loops into training and SOPs.
* Own the operational metrics the function reports on, including Time to Acknowledge (TTA), Time to Resolve (TTR), SLA compliance, and volume and failure trends by shift, partner, and rail; produce the weekly operations readout and be able to explain any number in it.
* Develop and maintain current, usable SOPs and runbooks that reflect how the team actually works; close gaps between practice and documentation, and run process changes through communication, training, adoption verification, and measurement.


**What You'll Bring To Circle**
 Core requirements
   

  

* 8\+ years in payment operations, payment investigations, settlement operations, or a comparable operations function at a payments company, fintech, or bank.
* 2\+ years directly managing a team of operations analysts as a Team Lead, Assistant Manager, or Manager, with real accountability for their output and not just work allocation; you are still hands\-on and want to stay that way.
* Hands\-on ownership of at least one full shift roster in a 24x7 or extended\-coverage operation; you have built the roster, run the coverage math, and handled the exceptions.
* Demonstrated ownership of training and ramp; you can name analysts you took from new to independent and describe how you developed them.
* Demonstrated ownership of process and documentation; you have written SOPs and runbooks that other people used, not just followed someone else’s.
* Cross\-border payments depth, including correspondent banking, SWIFT/MT103, local rails, reconciliation, exception handling, and settlement investigations.
* Comfortable working from data; you set targets, track them, and can defend the numbers.


 What will make you stand out
   

  

* You have done this in a team that was being built, not one that was already running; you set the process rather than inheriting it.
* You have run an operation where the SLA mattered to a customer or partner, and you can describe what you changed to hit it.
* You have exposure to stablecoins, crypto rails, or digital assets, or clear evidence that you pick up new domains quickly.
* You actively use AI tooling in your own work and have a point of view on where it can—and cannot—improve operations.

title: Commercial Finance & Operations Manager
description:
Artitude Home is a Singapore\-founded luxury home fragrance brand built at the intersection of art, fragrance and design.
 



 With a growing international footprint across the GCC, Europe and Asia, Artitude Home works with leading department stores, distributors, retailers and e\-commerce partners while continuing to expand its global wholesale and retail presence.
 



 As we enter our next stage of growth, we are looking for a hands\-on
 **Commercial Finance \& Operations Manager** 
 who can bring strong financial discipline, commercial thinking and operational control to the business.
 


 The Role
 
 This is not a traditional accounting role and it is not a purely strategic FP\&A position.
 



 We are looking for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of a growing consumer business — understanding margins, pricing, inventory, freight, customer profitability, working capital and operating costs — and turning those numbers into practical decisions.
 



 The core objective of the role is simple:
 



**Help Artitude Home grow profitably and build a clear, measurable path to positive EBITDA and sustainable cash flow.** 




 You will work closely with the Founder and the wider commercial and operations teams across Singapore, Europe, the Middle East and our supply chain partners.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesCommercial Finance \& Profitability
 
 Own and continuously improve our understanding of profitability across the business.
 



 This includes:
 


* Gross margin and contribution margin analysis
* Profitability by SKU, collection, customer, channel and market
* Landed\-cost calculations incorporating production, freight, duties, warehousing and fulfilment
* Distributor and wholesale pricing analysis
* Retail and e\-commerce margin analysis
* Pricing recommendations and scenario modelling
* Promotional and discount profitability
* Customer and account\-level profitability
* Identifying margin leakage and opportunities for margin improvement



 You should be able to clearly answer:
 



**Where are we making money, where are we losing money, and what should we change?** 



 Budgeting, Forecasting \& Path to Profitability
 
 Take ownership of the company's financial planning model and ensure it remains a practical management tool.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Maintain and update the annual budget
* Monthly actual vs budget reporting
* Rolling forecasts
* Revenue and gross\-margin forecasting
* Operating expense management
* Break\-even analysis
* EBITDA planning
* Cash\-flow forecasting
* Working\-capital monitoring
* Scenario modelling based on different revenue levels
* Identify actions required to achieve profitability



 The role should provide management with a clear monthly view of:
 



**Revenue → Gross Margin → Contribution → EBITDA → Cash** 



 Commercial Performance
 
 Work closely with the Founder and sales team to understand the commercial performance of the business.
 



 This includes:
 


* Sales performance versus targets
* Performance by market, distributor and retailer
* Opening orders and reorder analysis
* Commercial terms and margin implications
* Distributor economics
* Wholesale coefficients and pricing
* Payment terms and receivables
* Sales pipeline visibility
* Evaluating the financial impact of new markets and customers



 The objective is not simply to report sales but to understand the
 **quality and profitability of revenue** 
 .
 


 Inventory \& Operations
 
 Take a hands\-on role in ensuring smooth operations across the business.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Inventory planning and monitoring
* Stock visibility across warehouses and markets
* Replenishment planning
* Slow\-moving and ageing inventory analysis
* Purchase planning
* Coordination with suppliers and warehouse partners
* Freight and logistics cost monitoring
* Fulfilment\-cost analysis
* Improving inventory turns
* Supporting order fulfilment and operational problem\-solving
* Ensuring commercial, finance and inventory information remains aligned


 Financial \& Operational Controls
 
 Work with our accountants, bookkeepers and external partners to ensure accurate financial information and good operating discipline.
 



 This includes:
 


* Ensuring invoices and purchase orders are properly recorded
* Monitoring receivables and payment collections
* Reviewing supplier payments
* Maintaining cost and pricing databases
* Ensuring inventory reconciles with financial records
* Supporting month\-end reporting
* Establishing simple but effective internal processes and controls



 The role is expected to
 **oversee and use accounting information rather than spend the majority of its time performing bookkeeping** 
 .
 


 Founder Dashboard \& Management Reporting
 
 Create a concise monthly management dashboard covering:
 


* Revenue
* Gross margin %
* Contribution margin
* EBITDA
* Cash position
* Accounts receivable
* Inventory value
* Inventory ageing
* Sales by market/channel
* Customer profitability
* Key operating expenses
* Forecast versus budget



 The ability to turn complex financial information into
 **clear, actionable management insights** 
 is essential.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 


* Commercially minded
* Highly analytical
* Hands\-on and comfortable working with detail
* Strong with Excel and financial modelling
* Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment
* Able to move between finance and operations
* Comfortable challenging costs and commercial assumptions
* Organised and process\-driven
* Pragmatic rather than overly corporate
* Able to communicate financial information simply
* Comfortable working directly with a Founder



 You should enjoy understanding the mechanics of a business — from product cost and freight through to selling price, customer margin and ultimately EBITDA.
 


 Experience
 
 Ideally
 **6–10 years of relevant experience** 
 across commercial finance, finance business partnering, business finance or finance \& operations.
 



 Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly relevant:
 



 Luxury / Beauty / Fragrance / Fashion / Home \& Lifestyle / FMCG / Retail / Consumer Goods / E\-commerce
 



 Experience working with physical products and inventory is strongly preferred.
 



 International wholesale or distributor experience would be an advantage.
 


 What Success Looks Like
 
 Within the first 3–6 months, we would expect this person to have:
 


* Established reliable SKU and customer\-level margin reporting
* Built clear landed\-cost visibility across markets
* Taken full ownership of the budget and rolling forecast
* Established a monthly Founder dashboard
* Identified the biggest opportunities for margin improvement
* Improved inventory and working\-capital visibility
* Established clear customer and market profitability reporting
* Identified unnecessary operating costs
* Created a measurable roadmap towards EBITDA profitability
* Improved the overall operating rhythm and financial discipline of the business


 The Opportunity
 
 This is an opportunity to play a central role in building the commercial and operational foundations of a growing international luxury consumer brand.
 



 The role offers significant exposure to the Founder and the wider business and would suit someone who wants to be directly involved in
 **building a profitable business — not simply reporting its numbers.** 




 Apply to: info@artitudehome.com

title: Business Accountability Senior Manager- Technology Risk Delivery Management
description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Business Accountability Senior Manager.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage and develop teams of specialists and managers to oversee moderate to highly complex activities associated with the development and implementation of business\-specific programs, processes, and controls which identify, assess, monitor, measure, and mitigate risk
* Identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, risk mitigation, and control strategies
* Determine appropriate strategies and actions, interpret and develop policies and procedures, and provide leadership to strategize and execute a variety of programs, services, initiatives, protocols, and deliverables that are moderate to high\-risk within scope of responsibility
* Collaborate with and influence all levels of professionals including senior managers
* Engage and influence business heads, regulators, control management, risk, legal, and audit partners to successfully ensure appropriate management of business risk
* Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy


**Required Qualifications:**
* 7\+ years of risk management, business controls, or compliance experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3\+ years of management or leadership experience


**Desired Qualifications:**
**Delivery Intake \& Triage**
* Own the centralized delivery intake process for Technology delivery initiatives.
* Assess incoming demand for scope, priority, execution risk, stakeholder impact, and required level of support.
* Route work to the appropriate delivery owners and aligned DRM teams based on risk, execution needs, and program maturity.
* Maintain visibility of intake status, ownership, and next steps through a consistent tracking model.


**Portfolio Monitoring \& Execution Governance**
* Establish common portfolio monitoring routines across supported delivery workstreams.
* Track progress against milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and remediation commitments.
* Use common cadence, thresholds, and governance practices to identify execution gaps early.
* Provide consistent leadership updates on delivery status, risk posture, and items requiring decisions or escalation.
* Coordinate execution across Technology teams, CIO partners, control partners, and delivery stakeholders.
* Align delivery activities to agreed priorities, timelines, ownership, and escalation paths.
* Reduce duplicate touchpoints and handoffs by creating clear engagement expectations and operating routines.
* Ensure work moves through the delivery lifecycle with clear accountability and timely decision\-making.


**Risk\-Based Escalation \& Issue Resolution**
* Identify at\-risk initiatives, execution blockers, ownership gaps, and missed impacts through proactive monitoring.
* Escalate delivery risks using agreed thresholds, leadership forums, and defined escalation pathways.
* Drive resolution of delivery blockers by coordinating accountable owners and decision\-makers.
* Support earlier gap detection and stronger remediation completion through consistent tracking and follow\-up.


**Reporting, Communications \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Create standardized progress reporting, delivery dashboards, and risk\-based notifications for leadership and aligned teams.
* Communicate delivery status, dependencies, risks, and decisions in a concise and executive\-ready manner.
* Facilitate operating cadences, governance reviews, and stakeholder routines for the Delivery Management portfolio.
* Serve as the primary Delivery Management point of contact for intake, orchestration, monitoring, and escalation topics.


**Process Standardization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Standardize delivery playbooks, templates, engagement cadences, and escalation models.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual tracking, duplicate follow\-ups, rework, and inconsistent communications.
* Strengthening delivery management practices through automation, improved tooling, and data\-driven reporting where feasible.
* Promote a scalable approach that improves visibility, prioritization, accountability, and execution discipline.


**Job Expectations:**
* 7\+ years of strong experience in Delivery Management, Portfolio Management, Program Management, PMO, or Technology Transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex delivery portfolios with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Strong governance, reporting, escalation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to design and operate intake, prioritization, monitoring, and escalation frameworks.
* Comfort working with Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Business stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills, with ability to turn fragmented information into clear execution plans and leadership insights.
* People leadership experience with the ability to set direction, build capability, and drive accountability.
* Create a single, consistent Delivery Management operating model for intake, triage, progress tracking, risk identification, and escalation.
* Provide leadership visibility into delivery health, execution gaps, dependencies, and emerging risks.
* Coordinate execution across Technology stakeholders using standardized communications, reporting, and escalation pathways.
* Move the delivery management function from reactive follow\-up to proactive, risk\-based monitoring and orchestration.


**Posting End Date:**
 17 Sep 2026
   

  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.


**We Value Equal Opportunity**
 Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
   

  

 Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. title: Head, BRM Distribution
description:
**Job Summary**
 Define the role’s purpose and key accountabilities for leading first\-line business risk management across Branch Banking and Affluent, covering operational, conduct, regulatory, fraud, financial crime, client experience and governance risks.
   

  

* Act as the principal first\-line risk leader for Branch Banking and Affluent, enabling business heads, distribution leaders and segment teams to manage risks within appetite while delivering sustainable growth and fair client outcomes.
* Continuously assess risks arising from branch operations, affluent client propositions, sales and service practices, client journeys, regulatory change, transformation initiatives and third\-party / outsourced processes, and advise on appropriate mitigation and remediation actions.
* Ensure timely completion of BAU risk deliverables, including risk assessments, control testing, issue management, operational loss reporting, governance submissions, audit actions, regulatory action tracking and risk acceptance processes.
* Lead implementation of business risk management initiatives across Branch Banking and Affluent, ensuring control enhancements are practical, sustainable and aligned to client protection, regulatory expectations and business priorities.
* Accountable for ensuring material risks, control failures and residual risk exposures are assessed, documented and submitted through appropriate risk acceptance and governance channels in consultation with process owners, risk owners and second\-line teams.
* Responsible for implementation of the Control Sample Testing process, sampling approach, testing standards, Key Control Indicators and RCSA assessments across relevant branch and affluent processes.
* Responsible for ensuring the quality, accuracy and completeness of information recorded in risk tracking systems, and for driving timely resolution of outstanding issues, actions and remediation plans.
* Support the business in minimising operational risks and losses, ensuring material operational losses, fraud events, conduct issues and process failures are investigated and lessons are embedded to prevent recurrence.
* Ensure country\-level risk ownership is retained by business and process owners over centrally or GBS\-performed activities, including ownership of residual risk evaluations, validation outcomes and associated remediation activities.
* Identify non\-standard, manual or high\-risk branch and affluent processes, and ensure appropriate control mechanisms are implemented, monitored and improved for effectiveness.
* Proactively communicate emerging risks, control gaps and significant events to relevant business, risk, compliance and governance stakeholders.
* Coordinate and consolidate operational risk, conduct risk, fraud risk and loss reporting for Branch Banking and Affluent for submission to CNFRC, OTCR and relevant business governance forums.
* Design and implement control measures, monitoring plans and preventive risk indicators to strengthen compliance, operational resilience and client outcome governance.
* Coordinate periodic business monitoring, thematic reviews and self\-assessment activities across Branch Banking and Affluent, and escalate findings, breaches or adverse trends to business heads, CFCR, OTCR and other relevant stakeholders.
* Identify capability gaps and arrange targeted training on operational risk, conduct, fraud prevention, regulatory requirements and control ownership for branch and affluent teams.
* Carry out gap analysis between Group standards, regulatory circulars, country process notes and business practices, ensuring timely implementation of required changes.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Drive effective first\-line risk management, governance and compliance across Branch Banking and Affluent, ensuring that business growth, distribution performance, affluent client engagement and service delivery are supported by a robust, sustainable and client\-focused control environment.
* Understand the strategic priorities of Branch Banking and Affluent and ensure that risk and control requirements are embedded early in business planning, branch operations, sales governance, affluent client propositions, process changes and transformation initiatives.
* Maintain a strong understanding of branch distribution models, affluent relationship management, client lifecycle processes, sales and service controls, complaints, operational touchpoints and regulatory obligations to provide risk\-based advice and challenge to the business.
* Review branch and affluent controls, including control design, control performance, exceptions, complaints, incidents, audit findings, assurance outcomes and remediation actions, to ensure risks are identified, assessed, mitigated and monitored effectively.
* Build risk awareness across branch and affluent teams by identifying training needs, sharing lessons from issues and events, and promoting a culture of proactive risk identification, ownership, escalation, client protection and accountability.
* Provide guidance to Branch Banking and Affluent on maintaining an effective Management Control Approach, with focus on control design, operating effectiveness, timely remediation and continuous improvement in risk outcomes.
* Identify and assess risks arising from branch expansion, product distribution, affluent client engagement, digital\-assisted journeys, client communications, regulatory developments, thematic reviews and business transformation, and support implementation of proportionate controls in country.
* Ensure adherence to policies, standards and regulatory requirements applicable to Branch Banking and Affluent, and challenge processes, procedures or controls where improvements are required to strengthen client outcomes and risk management.
* Speak up on emerging risks, recurring control weaknesses, adverse client experience indicators, conduct concerns, fraud themes and regulatory matters, ensuring timely escalation and clear ownership of remediation.
* Responsible for identifying knowledge gaps and facilitating development of targeted operational risk, conduct, fraud and compliance training for branch and affluent teams.
* Participate in periodic peer reviews and cross\-business reviews to ensure consistency of risk management approach and support embedding of best practices across the distribution network.
* Identify, record, monitor and track issues, events, control weaknesses, risk acceptances and remediation actions relating to Branch Banking and Affluent.
* Track actions arising from internal audits, external audits, regulatory inspections, thematic reviews, client complaints, incidents, fraud events and assurance reviews through to sustainable closure.
* Ensure governance reporting is accurate, complete, timely and insight\-led, including risk dashboards, operational loss reporting, issue status, control performance, conduct indicators, fraud themes and regulatory updates.
* Conduct periodic thematic, analytical and deep\-dive reviews across branch operations, affluent client processes, sales governance, complaints, incidents and control outcomes to identify risk trends and drive preventive action.
* Monitor and support implementation of applicable regulations, internal standards and policy changes impacting Branch Banking, Affluent, client servicing and distribution\-related operational processes.


**Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Support India WRB, Branch Banking and Affluent teams in achieving the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles, including fair client outcomes, financial crime compliance, effective governance and the right conduct environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct, fraud, regulatory and compliance matters.
* Ensure adherence to applicable requirements prescribed by the Reserve Bank of India, SEBI, IRDAI, NSDL, CDSL and other relevant regulators, as applicable to branch banking, affluent client servicing, investment / insurance distribution and related operational processes.


**Stakeholders**
* Head Branch Banking, Head Affluent, Segment Heads, Regional and Branch Heads, Relationship Managers, Product Heads, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Operational Risk, Conduct and Financial Crime Risk, Legal, Group Risk stakeholders, Internal Audit, external auditors and relevant regulators.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate strong cross\-functional collaboration and leadership through proactive engagement with business heads, regional and branch leadership, affluent segment teams, process owners, risk owners, operations, technology and control functions.
* Strengthen the effectiveness of control monitoring, operational risk management, fraud prevention, conduct governance, regulatory compliance and client outcome governance at the business unit and branch network level.
* Support satisfactory outcomes from reviews undertaken by Group Internal Audit, regulators and external auditors through strong issue management, evidence quality and sustainable remediation.
* Ensure timely communication and implementation of changes to the regulatory environment, internal policies, standards and procedures issued by Legal, Compliance and Operational Risk Management.
* Ensure timely reporting, escalation and governance of operational risk exposures, conduct issues, fraud events, regulatory matters and control failures.
* Act as regulatory champion, process champion and first\-line risk advisor for Branch Banking and Affluent.


**Skills And Experience**
* Business Risk Management
* Branch Operations and Distribution Controls
* Conduct, Fraud and Financial Crime Risk
* Regulatory Risk and Governance
* Data Analytics and Risk Insight Generation
* People Leadership and Stakeholder Management


**Qualifications**
* Graduate or postgraduate qualification with significant experience in banking, branch distribution, affluent / wealth client servicing, business risk management, operational risk, conduct risk, compliance, audit, governance or control roles.
* Experience in first\-line risk management, regulatory engagement, senior stakeholder management and leading teams in a complex banking environment is preferred.

**What We Offer**
