title: FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable, Accounts Payable Operations team
description:
**Description**
 FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable
   

  

 Amazon Financial Operations \| Level 5 \| Full\-Time \| US Shift
   

  

 Every payment Amazon makes to a supplier starts with a promise \- and the Accounts Payable Operations team is the engine that keeps that promise, at massive scale, across dozens of subsidiaries and global marketplaces. As a FinOps Manager – AP, you’ll lead a core US\-shift team responsible for the full invoice lifecycle \- from ingestion through successful payment execution \- ensuring that tens of thousands of vendors worldwide are paid accurately and on time.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility leadership role at the intersection of operational excellence and financial transformation. You’ll own the transition of multiple subsidiary AP processes into a centralized operating model, build the playbooks that scale our operations for Amazon’s continued expansion, and drive automation initiatives that directly reduce manual touchpoints and cost\-per\-transaction. If you’re energized by building teams, simplifying complexity, and delivering measurable outcomes in a fast\-moving environment \- this role was made for you.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable will lead a team supporting core US\-shift AP operations and play a critical role in ensuring financial operations are scalable, efficient, and prepared for continued business growth.
   

  

 The role will have end\-to\-end ownership of the Accounts Payable process, from invoice ingestion through invoice processing, exception/hold resolution, and successful payment execution. The manager will work closely with upstream and downstream teams across Finance, Procurement, Technology, and business functions to ensure timely and accurate processing and payments.
   

  

 The role will also be responsible for transitioning and stabilizing AP processes for multiple subsidiaries. This includes building and developing high\-performing teams, managing operational performance, establishing priorities, driving process improvements, and ensuring compliance with global policies, controls, and service\-level commitments.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a strong people leader and operational owner with a passion for process innovation, automation, controllership, and customer/vendor experience. The candidate should be comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment and independently solving complex and ambiguous business problems.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 10\+ years of post\-qualification experience in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, Shared Services, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of project management and people management experience, including experience leading cross\-functional initiatives with technical and non\-technical teams.
* Strong understanding of Accounts Payable operations and end\-to\-end financial processes.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large\-scale operations, transitions, and process changes.
* Strong customer focus with experience managing internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently and make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Results\-oriented mindset with a demonstrated ability to delive


 r against challenging goals.
   

  

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability and willingness to work in flexible/night shifts, weekends, and holidays based on business requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience driving continuous improvement initiatives that improved controllership, operational efficiency, or scalability with measurable results.
* 4\+ years of experience identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, performing root\-cause analysis, and developing and implementing escalation/corrective\-action plans.
* 4\+ years of experience mentoring and developing junior finance, operations, or business team members.
* Experience managing global or multi\-geography Accounts Payable operations.
* Experience with process transitions, migrations, or integration of new subsidiaries.
* Experience working with automation, workflow, self\-service, or finance technology solutions.
* Experience developing operational metrics and using data to drive business decisions.


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead, manage, and develop a team of AP Specialists and Operations Managers supporting end\-to\-end Accounts Payable operations.
* Own day\-to\-day operational performance and ensure accuracy, timeliness, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Successfully lead the transition of multiple subsidiary AP processes into the operations team, ensuring smooth migration, stabilization, and business continuity.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, and career development for team members.
* Establish team priorities, allocate workload effectively, and ensure appropriate resource planning based on business requirements and volume forecasts.
* Drive systems, process, and operational improvements to enable on\-time and accurate vendor payments.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes through automation, standardization, and self\-service solutions.
* Own and drive adherence to AP policies, procedures, and controls while ensuring consistency across global entities.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex vendor, customer, payment, invoice, and operational issues, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate stakeholder communication.
* Proactively identify recurring issues, analyze service trends, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Develop, maintain, and monitor operational metrics and dashboards covering SLA performance, payment timeliness, productivity, quality, defects, backlog, cost, and customer/vendor experience.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
* Partner with Finance leadership to forecast future headcount requirements based on business growth, transaction volumes, country expansion, and operational demand.
* Expand self\-service capabilities and digital solutions to improve the vendor experience while reducing manual intervention.
* Provide regular weekly and monthly business reviews, performance updates, and operational insights to Director\- and VP\-level Finance stakeholders.
* Develop, implement, and maintain effective internal controls across AP processes.
* Partner with Internal Audit, controllership, compliance, and finance teams to address control gaps and audit requirements.
* Lead cross\-functional technology, systems, and process\-improvement initiatives involving Finance, Procurement, Operations, and technical teams.
* Work effectively with stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, including support for US business hours, flexible/night shifts, weekends, and holidays based on business requirements.
* Ensure operational readiness for new business launches, subsidiary transitions, process changes, and organizational growth.


 How you’ll spend your time: Expect roughly 40% leading and coaching your team, 25% on cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication, 20% on process improvement and automation projects, and 15% on deep\-focus analysis (metrics, controls, forecasting).
   

  

 People Leadership
   

  

 The manager will be responsible for building and maintaining a high\-performing AP organization by:
   

  

* Hiring and developing strong finance and operations talent.
* Establishing clear performance expectations and measurable goals.
* Conducting regular performance reviews and providing actionable feedback.
* Identifying development opportunities and creating career progression plans for team members.
* Coaching employees to improve operational, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
* Building a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, customer obsession, and operational excellence.


 Process \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* The role requires a strong focus on continuously improving AP operations by:
* Identifying process gaps, inefficiencies, and recurring defects.
* Performing root\-cause analysis and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Standardizing processes across subsidiaries and geographies.
* Reducing manual effort through automation and self\-service.
* Improving payment accuracy and timeliness.
* Driving measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, and customer/vendor experience.
* Establishing mechanisms to monitor and prevent negative service trends.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* The candidate will work extensively with Finance, Procurement, Controllership, Internal Audit, Technology, Operations, and external vendors across multiple geographies.
* The role requires the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, influence decisions, manage escalations, and drive cross\-functional initiatives without direct authority.


 A day in the life
   

  

 What This Role Offers You
   

  

 You’ll have a front\-row seat to Amazon’s financial infrastructure at global scale \- leading a team that directly impacts supplier relationships, cash management, and controllership across every marketplace Amazon operates in. This is not a maintain\-the\-status\-quo role: you’ll build new operating models, drive automation, and shape the future of how Amazon pays its partners.
   

  

 Key Performance Areas
   

  

**Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through**
* Operational Excellence – Accuracy, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.


 ii. Payment Performance – Timely and accurate vendor payments.
   

  

 iii. People Leadership – Team engagement, performance, retention, and career development.
   

  

 iv. Process Improvement – Automation, standardization, and measurable efficiency gains.
   

  

* Customer/Vendor Experience – Effective resolution of issues and improvement in service levels.


 vi. Controllership \& Compliance – Strong internal controls and audit readiness.
   

  

 vii. Cost Optimization – Productivity improvements and effective resource utilization.
   

  

 viii. Business Growth \& Scalability – Readiness to support new subsidiaries, geographies, volumes, and business requirements.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About the Team
   

  

 Accounts Payable Operations supports multiple geographies and marketplaces globally and provides critical financial services across the organization.
   

  

**The Team Is Responsible For**
* Manual and automated invoice processing.
* Invoice ingestion and validation.
* Resolution of invoice holds and exceptions.
* Ensuring timely and accurate supplier payments.
* Vendor account setup and maintenance.
* Responding to supplier and business partner queries.
* Supporting subsidiary transitions and process migrations.
* Driving automation and process improvements across AP operations.


 The team operates in a highly dynamic environment and partners with multiple global stakeholders to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely payments to suppliers while continuously improving the overall vendor experience.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of Accounts Payable (AP) experience
* 4\+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 4\+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision\-making experience
* 4\+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
* 3\+ years of directly managing and leading a team of 3\+ members experience
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience, or a PMP and 5\+ years of team management experience
* Experience in a customer\-focused field or business
* Experience working proactively and independently, meeting deadlines, and delivering on projects and tasks
* Experience in problem solving and delivering results
* Experience in oral and written communication
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Master's/Bachelor's degree with 10\+ years of post\-qualification experience in Shared Services, Accounts Payable
* Candidate is expected to collaborate with multiple geographies including US and work in flexible shifts/ night hours and during holidays/weekends based on business requirement


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* 4\+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
* 4\+ years of mentoring junior finance and/or business team members experience
* 4\+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience

title: Senior SME Consolidation
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary**
  

 NIQ is seeking a Senior SME – Consolidations to partner with the Global Process Owner (GPO) in managing and continuously improving the global consolidation and close process.
   

  

 This role is instrumental in ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of NIQ’s consolidated financial results, embedding robust governance, automation, and process standardisation across regions.
   

  

 The Senior SME acts as the technical deputy to the GPO, providing operational oversight, subject\-matter guidance, and analytical insights across the consolidation lifecycle. The role will also contribute to NIQ’s broader R2R transformation agenda, supporting initiatives under Project Compass and RTR Quality Board.
   

  

  

  





**Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Consolidation and Reporting**
  

 • Lead execution of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidations for NIQ entities in OneStream, ensuring accuracy and adherence to close timelines.
   

  

 • Validate consolidation entries, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation adjustments to ensure first\-time\-right financial results.
   

  

 • Partner with Corporate Accounting and Controllership to finalise management and statutory consolidation packs and ensure alignment of group reporting.
   

  

 • Support the GPO in monitoring Close Cockpit milestones and escalation management during close cycles.
   

  





**Governance and Standardisation**
  

 • Maintain and update process documentation, SOPs, and L4 process maps for the consolidation process.
   

  

 • Ensure consistency in consolidation methodologies, data mapping, and chart\-of\-accounts alignment across legal entities.
   

  

 • Support GPO in embedding internal controls (SOX) and ensuring full audit readiness across regions.
   

  

 • Perform process quality reviews and recommend corrective actions for control and reconciliation gaps.
   

  





**Technology and Automation**
  

 • Act as OneStream system SME, supporting configuration changes, system testing, and enhancement requests.
   

  

 • Partner with Enablement and IT to deliver automation and analytics initiatives (RPA, Power BI dashboards, consolidation exception reporting).
   

  

 • Develop and maintain standardised consolidation templates, mapping tables, and validation scripts.
   

  





**Business Partnering and Stakeholder Engagement**
  

 • Liaise with regional controllers, service delivery leads, and corporate accounting teams to ensure smooth consolidation execution and issue resolution.
   

  

 • Provide technical accounting and system support for mergers, acquisitions, and entity restructures.
   

  

 • Collaborate with FP\&A and Corporate Reporting teams to provide insights into consolidated P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow results.
   

  





**Continuous Improvement and Capability Building**
  

 • Drive root\-cause analysis of consolidation issues and lead remediation actions.
   

  

 • Support GPO in developing and delivering training modules for RTR teams on consolidation best practices.
   

  

 • Contribute to process transformation projects aimed at shortening the close cycle and improving data accuracy.
   

  





**Required Skills and Attributes
   

  

 Core Skills**
  

 • Deep technical expertise in global consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
   

  

 • Strong understanding of end\-to\-end RTR processes, including their interlinkages with FP\&A, Tax, and Controllership.
   

  

 • Hands\-on proficiency in OneStream, Hyperion, or equivalent EPM systems; good knowledge of SAP data structures and ledger logic (0L/1L).
   

  

 • In\-depth knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS, particularly consolidation accounting, equity method, and non\-controlling interests.
   

  

 • Proven experience in managing financial close governance, reconciliation frameworks, and control compliance.
   

  

 • Ability to interpret and communicate complex accounting and system issues clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

  

  





**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills (Modelled on GPO Capabilities)**
  

 • Process Excellence Mindset: Passion for continuous improvement, simplification, and first\-time\-right delivery.
   

  

 • Analytical Rigor: Ability to deep\-dive into data, identify anomalies, and provide actionable insights.
   

  

 • Influence Without Authority: Collaborates effectively across time zones, driving alignment without direct hierarchy.
   

  

 • Execution Discipline: Strong planning, prioritisation, and follow\-through to meet global close deadlines.
   

  

 • Change Agility: Comfortable working in a transformation environment with evolving systems and structures.
   

  

 • Stakeholder Stewardship: Builds trust with Controllers, SDLs, and Corporate Accounting through reliability and responsiveness.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
   

  

 • Professional qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

 • 10–15 years of experience in Finance Operations, with at least 5 years in consolidation or group reporting.
   

  

 • Prior experience in global consolidation and reporting for multinational organisations is essential.
   

  

 • Exposure to OneStream or Hyperion implementations, process transformation, and automation initiatives desirable.
   

  





**Success Profile**
  

 • Operates as the technical backbone of NIQ’s global consolidation process.
   

  

 • Acts as the operational deputy to the GPO, ensuring process execution excellence and data integrity.
   

  

 • Demonstrates strong technical, analytical, and leadership maturity, preparing for future progression to process\-ownership roles.
   

  

 • Delivers accuracy, control, and speed — the three cornerstones of NIQ’s consolidation success.

title: Logistics Manager
description:

 **Logistics Manager** 
 to lead end\-to\-end outbound and reverse logistics operations across Dentalkart's ful fil ment network. * Proven experience managing courier and 3PL partners.

* Excellent analytical skills with hands\-on experience in Excel, SQL, and Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

 Products and services included in this area are electric generators for hydraulic and thermal power plants (biomass), hydro turbines (small hydroelectric plants or PCH, and hydroelectric generators or CGH)), wind turbines, transformers, substations, control panels and system integration services.

 **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations – Supply Chain Management Manager** 
 to join our Customer Success team. This role is crucial in ensuring the stability and effectiveness of our D365 F\&O system in the supply chain domain. * Prepare/maintain support documentation, configuration guides and process documentation.
* Support implementation of enhancements through the full software development life cycle, hotfixes and service updates.
* Support period\-end/year\-end business activities.
* Guide clients on best practices for configuration/processes and internal controls within D365 F\&O.
* Continuous self\-learning of new features/functionality/technologies as well as guiding younger team members on their cases/career.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience with D365 F\&O
* Strong functional knowledge of D365 F\&O SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Product Information Management, Warehouse Management).
* Microsoft certifications for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management (preferred).
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, meticulous attention to detail and collaborative teamwork abilities.
* Clear, confident English communication – comfortable engaging directly with U.S. counterparts during the alternate shift.
* Ability to manage multiple client expectations and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience supporting integrations between D365 SCM and 3PL, shipping carriers, or EDI platforms.
* Familiarity with manufacturing and distribution best practices.
* Experience with multi\-entity or global deployments.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience managing business transformation and debottlenecking projects.
* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Good functional knowledge of D365 F\&O SCM Asset Management


 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**About Blue Dart Express India**

**Position Overview**
 Regional leadership role accountable for the operational performance, throughput, productivity, safety, and service quality of Surface Hub Operations across assigned regional hubs. Owns inbound and outbound operations, shipment processing, manpower productivity, infrastructure readiness, and operational compliance to ensure seamless movement of shipments across the Surface Network.
   

  

 Leads Hub Operations teams and drives standardized execution, operational discipline, damage prevention, safety compliance, and continuous improvement while ensuring alignment with regional network requirements and customer service commitments.
   

  

 This role operates as a regional execution and governance function, working closely with Regional Surface Fleet \& Network Manager, Regional Senior Manager – PUD Operations, CPU Operations, Air Operations, Engineering, Finance, Commercial, and HR teams to deliver safe, reliable, and cost\-efficient hub operations.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To build and operate high\-performing Surface Hub Operations by driving throughput, turnaround time, shipment quality, safety, manpower productivity, and infrastructure utilization while ensuring seamless connectivity across the regional logistics network.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership**
* Execute regional Surface Hub strategies aligned with operational objectives, customer SLAs, and business growth.
* Translate regional operational initiatives into effective hub execution plans and drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure alignment of hub operations with regional network priorities and operational governance.


**Leadership**
* Lead and manage Hub Operations teams, ensuring alignment to productivity, service quality, safety, and operational excellence objectives.
* Build leadership capability, succession planning, and operational bench strength while fostering a high\-performance culture.
* Drive employee engagement, performance management, and adherence to organizational policies and operational standards.


**Operational Excellence**
* Own and govern inbound, outbound, sorting, loading, unloading, and dispatch operations to achieve throughput and turnaround time targets.
* Optimize manpower deployment, shift planning, dock utilization, and equipment usage to improve operational efficiency.
* Monitor operational performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to improve productivity and service quality.


**Hub Infrastructure \& Resource Management**
* Ensure optimum utilization and operational readiness of hub infrastructure, docks, conveyors, scanners, MHE, and other operational equipment.
* Plan manpower and operational resources based on shipment volumes, business forecasts, and peak season requirements.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and infrastructure improvements with Engineering teams to ensure uninterrupted operations.
* Ability to source, negotiate and deploy large workforce service partners


**Damage Control, Safety \& Compliance**
* Drive damage prevention initiatives through standardized shipment handling, loading, unloading, and storage practices.
* Ensure compliance with EHS standards, safety protocols, statutory requirements, and operational SOPs across all hub activities.
* Conduct regular safety audits, incident reviews, and corrective action plans to minimize operational risks and improve workplace safety.


**Cost Optimization \& Productivity**
* Improve hub productivity and PPH through manpower optimization, process standardization, and efficient resource utilization.
* Monitor operational costs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining service quality.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce handling errors, operational waste, and processing costs.


**Process Re\-engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead Lean and Continuous Improvement initiatives to improve throughput, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Standardize operational practices and drive digital adoption across Surface Hub Operations.
* Implement best practices and monitor realization of productivity and quality improvements.


**Stakeholder \& Governance**
* Collaborate with Regional Surface Fleet \& Network Manager to ensure timely vehicle placement, dispatch planning, and network connectivity.
* Coordinate with Regional Senior Manager – PUD Operations, CPU Operations, Air Operations, Commercial, Engineering, Finance, HR, and Network Planning teams for seamless end\-to\-end operations.
* Act as the regional SME for Surface Hub Operations during operational reviews, audits, and governance forums.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education: Bachelor's degree (Engineering / Operations / Supply Chain preferred); MBA/PG desirable.
* Experience: 8–10 years of experience in logistics operations with strong exposure to Surface Hub Operations, Distribution Centres, Warehousing, Cross\-dock Operations, or Transportation Networks.
* Proven experience in managing high\-volume operational facilities, leading large operational teams, and driving productivity, safety, and service excellence across multiple shifts.
* Exposure to manpower planning, hub infrastructure management, process optimization, damage prevention, and operational compliance preferred.
* Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Transportation, Warehousing, 3PL, eCommerce Logistics, Supply Chain.

title: Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Sr. CTM) - Internal Medicine
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 PPD’s (a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific) mission is to improve health. It starts as an idea to find a cure. It becomes a life saved. All in\-between, it’s you! We know that meaningful results not only require the right approach, but also the right people. We invite you to re\-imagine health promoting protocols with us, working alongside our talented, bright and energetic teams.
   

  

 Our therapeutic team directs, coordinates and manages the technical and operational aspects of projects, securing the successful completion of clinical trials. The team is therapeutically aligned to respond better to our customer needs.
   

  

**The therapeutic scope includes Cardiovascular \& Internal Medicine** 
**\-** 
 Dermatology, GI, (UC/CD), Cardiovascular, Liver, Nephrology, Immunology, Rare Disease, Diabetes, Obesity, Dyslipidemia, Women's Health.
   

  

 As a Senior Clinical Team Manager (Sr. CTM), you combine deep knowledge, therapeutic expertise, and robust tools to help our clients deliver life\-changing therapies to market. You take ownership of all start\-up and clinical deliverables, anticipate problems, find solutions and deliver results; coordinating the activities of start\-up and clinical team members which are allocated to a project on a Regional or Country basis.
   

  

 You will work in partnership with the Project Manager to ensure the necessary training, tracking and quality systems are in place for the clinical management team and be primarily responsible for the start\-up and clinical deliverables of the Project within agreed timelines and budget. Clinical Team Managers provide contact and support to the project sponsor for all clinical aspects.
   

  

 At PPD we hire the best, develop ourselves and each other, and recognize the power of being one team. We offer continued career advancement opportunities, award winning training and benefits focused on the health and wellbeing of our employees.
   

  

 Summarized Purpose:
   

  

 Accountable for achieving the final start\-up and clinical deliverables (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time period specified in the contract with the customer. Interprets data on complex issues and makes good business decisions with support from line management. Works to ensure that all start\-up and clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations. Maintains profitability by ensuring start\-up and clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the country start\-up and clinical team. Typically works independently on projects of moderate to high complexity and may assume regional lead or Clinical Study Manager responsibilities.
   

  

 Essential Functions:
   

  

* Manages all clinical and start\-up activities, operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of moderate to high complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Lead CTM responsibilities on regional level, Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities or take on additional responsibilities; e.g. process improvements, manage complex programs, have wider management or project coordination responsibilities.
* Acts as the primary point of contact for study start\-up activities and site activation across the assigned region and/or globally, driving timelines and ensuring operational excellence.
* Develops start\-up and clinical tools (e.g. Essential Document Checklist, Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the study requirements and Data Quality Plan. Contributes to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensures timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required. Collaborates with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand\-off meetings.
* Collaborates with the start\-up country team, regulatory, clinical team and other departments as needed to meet deliverables of the project. Regularly communicates with the team and leads team meetings to ensure that timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Responsible for the implementation and training of standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Responsible for the timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department.
* Ensures achievement of the start\-up and clinical deliverable within the contractual time period specified by preparing and monitoring start\-up and clinical activity timelines and metrics, providing status updates to the project manager, regularly reviewing projects using tracking and management tools, implementing recovery actions, reviewing monitoring visit reports, and managing CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitors clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. May routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials.
* Communicates with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, case report form completion and other study\-related issues.
* Coordinates all start\-up activities and ensures that essential document quality meets the expectation of Regulatory Compliance Review. Ensures timely regulatory submissions (if appropriate) are addressed. Reviews and follows up on all questions raised by ethics committees. Responsibilities may vary based on project timelines.
* Provides input into preparation of forecast estimates for start\-up and clinical activities. Responsible for start\-up and clinical resource management, assignment, delegation of clinical responsibilities and identification of additional resource requirements.


 Education and Experience:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
* Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5\+ years).
* In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.


 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
   

  

* Strong experience managing end\-to\-end clinical trial start\-up (SSU) activities
* Experience leading cross\-functional collaboration with CAS, RAL, ICF PM, GCS, Contract Management, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless study execution.
* Strong leadership skills, effective at mentoring and training, and capable of motivating and integrating teams
* Strong planning and organizational skills to enable effective prioritization of workload and workload of team members
* Strong interpersonal and problem\-solving skills to enable working in a multicultural matrix organization
* Solid understanding of change management principles
* Comprehensive understanding of the practices, processes, and requirements of start\-up and clinical monitoring
* Strong judgment, decision making, escalation, and risk management skills
* Effective oral and written communication skills, including English language proficiency
* Capable of evaluating own and team members workload against project budget and adjust resources accordingly
* Strong financial acumen and knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and fiscal management
* Strong attention to detail
* In\-depth understanding of relevant regulations e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc.
* Strong computer skills to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.
* Capable of independently managing clinical only studies


 Working Environment:
   

  

* PPD, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:
* Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.
* Able to work upright and stationary for typical working hours.
* Able to work in non\-traditional work environments.
* Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.
* Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.
* May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments.
* This role requires independent travel up to 20%, inclusive of traveling in automobiles, airplanes, and trains.


 Our 4i Values:
   

  

* Integrity – Innovation – Intensity – Involvement
* If you resonate with our 4i values above, and ultimately wish to accelerate the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics for some of the world’s most urgent health needs, submit your application – we’d love to hear from you!

title: Area Business Manager
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
   

  

 Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
   

  

 Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial and team activities across a defined area in India to deliver measurable business results. You will build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals, hospital teams and internal partners to ensure high\-quality engagement. We value clarity, teamwork and practical problem solving. This role offers visible impact, career growth and the chance to help GSK unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: \- Develop and deliver an area business plan that meets local objectives and patient needs. \- Build and maintain trusted relationships with clinicians, hospital teams and healthcare decision makers. \- Lead, coach and support field teams to achieve targets and grow professionally. \- Coordinate with medical, market access and marketing colleagues to align local activities. \- Use market and customer insights to refine plans and improve local decisions. \- Monitor area performance, manage budgets and ensure accurate, timely reporting. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals \- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, business or related field. \- Minimum 3 years’ experience in pharmaceutical field roles, territory management or sales. \- Experience managing teams or leading field activities. \- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. \- Comfortable using CRM systems, Microsoft Office and digital tools. \- Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel across the assigned area. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus \- Experience working with hospitals, specialty or tertiary care providers. \- Background in specialty or complex therapeutic areas. \- Experience collaborating with medical affairs, access or procurement teams. \- Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into practical actions. \- Prior coaching, mentoring or line management experience. \- Familiarity with virtual customer engagement and omnichannel approaches. Working arrangement This role is on\-site with regular travel across the assigned area. Hybrid working options may be discussed based on business needs and local policy. What we value in you We value clear communicators who listen and learn. We look for people who work well with others and put patients first. You should be curious, adaptable and comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. How to apply If this role motivates you and you want to grow while making a real difference to patients, please submit your CV and a short note explaining your interest. We look forward to hearing how you can contribute to our work to get ahead of disease together.
   

  

**Skills**
 Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
   

  

**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
 GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
   

  

 People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
   

  

**Inclusion at GSK:**
 As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
   

  

 Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
   

  

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
 GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
   

  

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

title: Head of Business Applications for Grid Technologies Digital Services
description:
Head of GT DS BAP (Business Applications)
   

  

 Job Family: Information Technology
   

  

 Department: SE GT DS BAP
   

  

 Job Grade: Global \- Senior Management
   

  

**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As the Head of Business Applications, you are the leader of the development and delivery engine for GT Digital Services. You are accountable for the entire business application portfolio that runs our global Grid Technologies business from the PLM systems and platforms that design our Manufacturing and Production to the Engineering and Project and Service Platforms. Linked to our factories, and the CRM that manages our customer relationships, and the PM ecosystem that enables complex project execution. Certain platforms and applications are delivered by your own organization; others are delivered by global Digital Core Value Centers for the GT Business or by external parties.
   

  

 Ensuring that projects and services are delivered flawlessly is your ambition. Your day will be spent leading a large, diverse organization of technology experts and managers, overseeing the execution of major digital programs, ensuring the operational stability of our critical systems, managing external service providers and partnering closely with our Business Partnering teams to manage and deliver on a complex portfolio of business demands.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Leading, inspiring, and developing a large, multi\-layered, and growing organization of internal and external application managers, developers, service owners, and data experts, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement
* Establishing a strong, collaborative partnership with Grid Technologies Process Owners in the business and Business Integration Architects in our GT DS Governance \& Digital Architecture team to ensure our application platforms are perfectly aligned with our end\-to\-end business processes and enterprise architecture
* Being accountable for the end\-to\-end delivery of all application projects and programs, ensuring they are executed on time, within budget, and to a high standard of quality
* Championing and driving the modernization of our application landscape and engineering practices, leading the transition towards an Agile operating model and challenging the status quo to achieve productivity increase while supporting our growth.
* Managing the entire application portfolio lifecycle for Grid Technologies, making strategic decisions on technology selection, investment, and the rationalization of legacy systems
* Ensuring the operational stability, performance, and security of all business\-critical applications, in line with agreed\-upon service levels


**What You Bring**
* Longstanding experience in a senior leadership role, managing large\-scale application development and operations teams (50\-100\+ FTEs) within a global, industrial or manufacturing company
* Proven experience in managing strategic vendors and technology suppliers, including contract negotiation, performance management, and leveraging effective sourcing strategies for the benefit of the business
* You are a technology leader who speaks the language of the business. You have a proven ability to connect technology investments to tangible business outcomes and to manage a large and complex budget effectively
* Strong change management capability and proven transformation experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading organizations through complex technology and business transformations, driving cultural change, and ensuring sustainable adoption across globally distributed teams
* Expert\-level knowledge of the core enterprise application platforms that underpin the industrial value chain, including PLM, ERP, MES, CRM/FSM, PM, as well as demonstrated experience in implementing and scaling modern software engineering practices, including Agile methodologies (SAFe, Scrum), CI/CD, and DevOps. At best you have a background in applications programing or solutions development, and you are very familiar with the world of IT applications.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), data architecture, and AI/ML principles, as well as deep expertise in IT Service Management (ITSM/ITIL), application portfolio management, and large\-scale program management
* Demonstrated experience in leading large, globally distributed, and multi\-layered technology organizations with a proven ability to lead and develop other managers, as well as exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical strategies and roadmaps to senior business executives and, in parallel, to guide and motivate deep technical specialists


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology team enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100\.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
 In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer\-financed company pension scheme.
   

  

 We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder.
   

  

 We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity.
   

  

 The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us.
   

  

 We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self\-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose.
   

  

 In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part\-time work or even a sabbatical.
   

  

 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

title: Learning Operations Expert - RDT Performance & Insights
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 Technology Consultant Learning Operations Expert
   

  

**Introduction** 
 As a Technology Consultant at the SE6 level within RDT Performance \& Insights, you will take on a matrix leadership role to deliver on a diversity of high\-impact products and multi\-faceted projects. You will lead both internal and external teams or squads in a matrix organization, developing advanced approaches like Agile backlog management, and driving the timeline and strategy across product teams. By applying your deep expertise in consultancy and proficient business process domain knowledge, you will solve unusually complex problems with highly innovative solutions, manage high\-level stakeholder relationships across the enterprise, and actively mentor colleagues to foster a collaborative and high\-performing environment.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
* Lead Matrix Squads \& Deliveries: Lead internal, external, and unofficial teams across matrix organizations to successfully deliver on a wide diversity of high\-impact products and learning operations projects
* Architect Agile Timelines: Develop and implement advanced operational approaches—such as Agile backlog management—defining clear delivery timelines and priorities across product teams and squads
* Manage Enterprise Backlogs: Prioritize, plan, and report execution status at the multi\-product, enterprise, or product\-line level to ensure alignment with business objectives
* Solve Complex Technical Challenges: Conduct root\-cause analysis and problem\-solving for unusually complex issues, proposing highly innovative solutions and process improvements
* Influence Product Line Strategies: Shape product and product\-line strategies by applying in\-depth industry trends, advanced data analysis, and technical principles for maximum value creation
* Manage Enterprise Stakeholders: Build and maintain high\-level relationships with key enterprise stakeholders, ensuring project outcomes align with strategic expectations across multiple portfolios
* Tailor Strategic Communications: Communicate complex technical information, risks, and proposed solutions effectively across the enterprise, adapting messaging and channels for diverse audiences
* Foster Collaborative Environments: Lead cross\-product collaborative team environments and champion organizational development initiatives, such as showing active leadership in Communities of Practice (CoPs)


**Who you are:**
* Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
* Experienced Technology Consultant: You bring 5\+ years of consultancy experience, including 3\+ years of specialized experience in life sciences/pharma or the assigned business function being supported
* Consultancy Domain Expert: You possess advanced knowledge of consultancy concepts and practices, with deep expertise in at least one primary consultancy capability and business process domain knowledge
* Technical \& Process Analyst: You demonstrate strong capabilities in applying advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis
* Complex Problem Solver: You have a proven track record of working on multi\-faceted projects and successfully resolving unusually complex problems with innovative technical solutions
* Enterprise Stakeholder Manager: You bring exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate enterprise\-level portfolios and tailor messaging to diverse audiences
* Mentoring \& Agile Leader: You possess a demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues, provide constructive feedback, lead matrix teams, and drive organizational development initiatives (e.g., CoPs)


**Why Join Us?**
* Remuneration: Competitive base salary paired with an attractive performance incentive scheme
* Security: Premium health insurance covering you and your family, alongside a high\-matching Provident Fund
* Well\-being: Flexible working arrangements, generous annual leave, and global professional growth opportunities


**Call to Action:**
 Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
   

  

 \#RDT2026
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Why should you apply to this role?**
 The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision\-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large\-scale Cloud migrations.
   

  

 You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross\-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:**

description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
 Program Coordinator
   

  

**Purpose Of The Job**
 A Program Coordinator (PC) works with a team of Community Mobilizers in the communities to enable mutual transformation – in the lives of children, families, supporters and WV staff themselves. The role serves as the primary link between the WV India Area Development Program office and the community mobilisers focusing on working with local groups and organisations to contribute towards child well\-being priorities in the area.
   

  

 A Programme coordinator acts as a facilitator and helps the community mobiliser’s teams to build on their existing strengths and facilitate links to technical support. They will be also responsible for a cluster to implement programmes and sponsorship in addition to providing coaching and mentoring.
   

  

**Key Deliverables**
* Ensure the effective communication of WV India identity, mission, vision, core values and approach to development including child sponsorship.

* Facilitate community based monitoring of programmes \& monitoring support to the community mobilisers s within the
* Monitor the end user issues within the PFA.

 As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 You will be part of our Sea Logistics Team to add your expertise \+ skills to the delivery of Customer \+ Product Excellence.
   

  

 Your primary objective is to drive \+ grow the reefer product by developing a strategy to gain \+ retain customers.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* To ensure your local product strategy aligns with the regional strategy \+ fits the local market.
* To build a local operational structure with reefer dedication within the customer \+ operational care locations (CCL \+ OCC) that creates \+ maintains reefer expertise, aiming for zero operational failures for temperature sensitive cargo.
* To ensure profitability across the profit \+ loss statement (P\+L), proactively following up on discrepancies.
* To manage local carrier relationships; ensuring access to appropriate escalation channels.
* To take the lead in local reefer pricing in coordination with the regional reefer trade manager.
* To build a reefer development team and support the KAM team and field sales where needed.
* To take the lead in setting up or maintaining a GxP Pharma branch to ensure operational excellence for pharmaceutical clients where demand exists.
* To provide regular reefer training.


**What we would like you to bring**
* 10\+ years of experience in Sea Logistics / Ocean Freight, with strong Reefer exposure.
* Proven Business Development experience in Reefer, Perishables, and/or Healthcare/Pharma.
* Strong experience in customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth.
* Hands\-on P\&L and profitability management experience.
* Strong ocean carrier management, including pricing, negotiations, and capacity.
* Experience leading and developing sales/product teams.
* Strong relationships with key customers, KAMs, and field sales teams.
* Good knowledge of Reefer operations and cold\-chain logistics.
* Ability to develop and execute a Pan\-India Reefer strategy.


**What's in it for you**
* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100\+ countries.
* People\-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning \& Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world\-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation \& Sustainability: Be part of a future\-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards \& Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
* As a Customer Fulfillment Team Manager, you will lead a team of 8–15 Customer Operations Specialists to deliver operational and service excellence, strengthen customer order processes, and improve supply chain efficiency. You will create a culture of belonging, coach and develop team members, and work with Customer Fulfillment, Logistics Operations, the Customer Center of Excellence, and cross\-functional partners to execute customer strategies and continuously improve standard processes. The role includes daily direction setting, resource allocation, onboarding, training, issue resolution, and accountability for process performance. Based in Mumbai, this hybrid role reports to the Customer Fulfillment Head and works the 3:30 PM to 12:30 AM shift, collaborating with demand, deployment, product supply management, customer order services, replenishment teams, and regional counterparts.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Lead and manage a team of 8\-15 Customer Operations Specialists, ensuring adherence to customer order process standards and delivery of customer initiatives.
* Educate, coach, and motivate team members while strengthening customer operations and SAP technical capabilities.
* Build a culture of belonging through individual development plans, team camaraderie, open communication, trust, and respect.
* Provide guidance on order\-to\-cash processes, including allocations, order additions, and pricing issues, and implement improvements that enhance efficiency and accuracy.
* Own onboarding and continuous training in partnership with the New Hire Training and Process Lead, including staffing coordination and training execution.
* Partner with Customer Fulfillment, Logistics Operations, Warehousing, Transportation, Sales and cross\-functional teams to eliminate losses, share information, and maintain standard process rigor.
* Provide daily leadership and direction for customer strategies and priorities; lead the Daily Direction Setting process, including team health checks, prioritization, and resource allocation.
* Lead continuous improvement, maintain standard processes and team accountability, and ensure effective communication and alignment across customer teams.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Experience: 7–10 years of related experience in supply chain management, logistics, customer operations, manufacturing, or a similar environment.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP ERP and supply chain processes; strong data analysis and interpretation skills; working knowledge of tools such as Excel, SQL, or Tableau; and experience with process mapping, standardization, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and process performance monitoring.
* Soft Skills: Strong people leadership, communication, collaboration, mentoring, motivation, conflict resolution, negotiation, analytical and critical thinking, customer orientation, attention to detail, and the ability to remain calm and systematic under pressure.
* People Management: Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and managing teams; conducting performance reviews and providing feedback; building inclusive team environments; resolving team dynamics; and leading cross\-functional groups.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of related experience, particularly in supply chain planning and execution, logistics, manufacturing, or customer operations.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Experience with SAP implementation or upgrades, relevant SAP modules, and training team members on SAP best practices.
* Experience with quality management systems or continuous improvement methods such as ISO or Six Sigma, including process audits and assessments.
* Experience leading diverse and cross\-functional teams, using customer satisfaction metrics and feedback to improve operations, and managing end\-to\-end supply chain risks and bottlenecks.


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

**Process Overview**
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. The team is also responsible for running valuation controls to ensure fair value of balance sheet in accordance with internal valuation methodology and regulatory requirements. This includes independent price verification of both vanilla securities/derivatives and complex/illiquid assets such as exotic derivatives and distressed assets. Additionally, the team also calculates relevant valuation adjustments including adjustments for illiquidity, concentration, model limitations etc. as applicable. The team is also responsible for calculating and reporting prudential valuation adjustments on a quarterly basis.
   

  

 The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, valuation control and methodology (GVG) teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description**
 IPV Center of Excellence forms part of the GBAM CFO Group and is a control and business advisory function. The team’s work primarily covers valuation controls for various asset classes across Global Banking and Markets, with a dynamic book of work providing opportunities to centralize, enhance and implement best practices for global valuation routines.
   

  

 We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the valuations control area for one of the asset classes within FICC Macro (Rates/FX/Commodities) / FICC Micro (Credit/Mortgages/Munis) / XVA / Equities businesses in Global Markets. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to perform Independent Price Verification, Valuation Adjustments, Prudent Valuations and Fair Value Hierarchy assessment, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation.
   

  

 The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Finance and Global Valuations Group (GVG) teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job. The team is also encouraged to take part in employee engagement and diversity and inclusion initiatives to help continue to make Bank of America a great place to work.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Performing the calculation and analysis of valuation controls including IPV, valuation adjustments and prudent valuation adjustments, as well as ownership for Fair Value Hierarchy levelling.
* Working with the Global Valuation Group to ensure ongoing review \& enhancement of valuation control methodologies and practices.
* Ensuring procedure documents are accurate and up to date.
* Assisting in the streamlining and enhancement valuation processes and becoming actively involved with system development ranging from technical enhancements and new product releases to automation of existing processes.
* Engaging with the key stakeholders including Front Line Units.
* A strong understanding of valuation controls, regulatory rules and governance including Independent Price Verification, Valuation Adjustments and Prudential Valuation.


**Requirements**
**Education :** 
 Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute with relevant experience in Valuation Control or Global Markets environment and organization of similar scale with US GAAP, IFRS, IAS reporting framework with an interest and aptitude for derivative products.
   

  

 Certifications If Any
   

  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred.
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus.
* Ability to use Access or VBA would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly.


**Experience Range :** 
 7\+ years of experience in Global Markets Valuation Control or similar roles
   

  

**Foundational Skills**
* Alteryx / Tableau / Python knowledge would be an added advantage.
* Have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner.
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels.
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated self\-starter.

**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Markets Global Valuation Group (GVG) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for providing valuation and independent price verification methodology support to Business Finance \& Control (BFC) teams for execution of IPV, calculation of valuation adjustments and prudential valuation adjustments. The team is also responsible for reporting and governance across all valuation processes. Additionally, the team works on a number of regulatory deliverables related to valuations and drives the overall valuation control automation agenda in partnership with Technology and other stakeholders.
   

  

 The team works closely with front office, middle office, traders, business finance controllers, market risk, quantitative risk and technology teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 We are looking to hire a seasoned leader in the Global Valuations Group to project manage number of regulatory deliverables for GM \& GCIB Finance organization. The person will be responsible for planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases. They will be required to manage stakeholders from different divisions within the bank to ensure that right responsibilities are allocated to right teams and the teams deliver on those in a timely fashion. They will be helping the team put together regulatory submissions, will track progress and milestones, escalate risks as needed and facilitate issue resolution.
   

  

 Given this role will be part of the valuations group and will involve interactions with senior management of technical functions, we need the person to have a deep understanding of all regulatory guidelines (like CCAR stress testing, Prudential Valuation guidelines from a PRA and ECB perspective, ICAAP etc.). Additionally, they should also have a good knowledge of financial products and their valuations. Ideally, this role will best suit a person who has already been managing such technical regulatory projects for multiple years.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Planning of regulatory engagement through the cycle from early notification to remediation phases
* Stakeholder management including ensuring adequate ownership and responsibilities of the different parties involved
* End to end project management of regulatory deliverables including putting together submissions, tracking of progress and milestone, escalation of risks and issues and facilitating issue resolution
* Providing upward communication on project progress to CFO senior leadership
* Ensuring high quality outputs from SME team by setting standards and providing guidance on expectations
* Interpret regulatory changes and engage with CFO teams to perform impact assessments and drive change so that we are compliant with the new changes
* Put together technical presentations in partnership with CFO teams
* Drive the operational excellence agenda, ensuring process standardization, controls maturity, and continuous improvement across business‑critical activities.
* Drive valuation related projects such as market data assessment for various asset classes, back\-testing of results as per regulatory guidelines, drive intra\-month prices testing of results etc.
* Manage the overall Model governance process for valuation related models
* Identify, document, and assess AI opportunities; collaborate with Technology, FLUs, and SMEs to evaluate feasibility, ROI, risk considerations, and operational impact.
* Ensure adherence to AI use‑case governance, including risk alignment, model‑development documentation, compliance with enterprise AI policies, and responsible‑AI practices.
* Govern technology and change portfolios, ensuring transparency, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery accountability.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate/ Postgraduate in Finance/Management from Tier I/II institute
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 12–18 years of relevant experience in finance domain related to project management of quantitative/technical regulatory projects or Valuations / Valuation Governance
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Good understanding of regulatory landscape (Prudential valuation guidelines, ICAAP, CCAR, Valuation principles)
* Ability to interpret regulatory guidelines (existing and forthcoming) and identify gaps/perform impact assessments
* Strong project management skills with prior experience of running end to end project management for regulatory engagements ideally for large banks
* Strong organization and structured thinking
* Strong communication skills to be able to present to a highly technical and senior audience
* Strong written communication skills and dashboarding skills
* Good knowledge of global markets products along with basic risk and valuation principles
* Attention to details and rigor to meet expectations or internal audit and supervisor requirements.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines
* Strong technology skills (understanding of automation tools such as Alteryx) and understanding of AI tools to enable identification and implementation of OPEX opportunities
* Experience working with Technology partners on architecture discussions, feasibility assessments, and solution design


**Additional Skills**
* Prior experience leading engagement with model governance and awareness of model governance life cycle
* Hands on experience with coding (ex: Python)
* Hands on experience in managing AI projects at large scale
* Strong understanding of Market risk and valuation principles.
* Prior experience performing market data assessment and working with vendors on assessing quality of data


**Work Timings\***
 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Mumbai/Gurgaon
