* **Title** 
 : Delivery Lead — Social \& Search Ops
* **Location** 
 : Bengaluru, India (Work from Office, 5 days a week)
* **Timings** 
 : 2\-11 pm



  





**About Joveo** 




 As the global leader in AI\-powered recruitment marketing, we are transforming talent attraction and recruitment media buying for the world’s largest and smartest employers, staffing businesses, RPOs, and recruitment advertising agencies.
 



  





 The Joveo platform enables businesses to attract, source, engage, and hire the most relevant candidates on time, within their budget. Powering millions of jobs every day, our data\-driven recruitment marketing platform uses advanced data science and machine learning to dynamically manage and optimize talent sourcing and applications across all online channels while providing real\-time insights at every step of the job seeker journey, from click to hire.
 



  





**About the Role** 



* The Delivery Lead is the most senior role in the Social \& Search Operations team. You own the business — revenue, client outcomes, team performance, and the operating model that ties it all together.
* The team is structured in pods. Each pod is an Account Manager and one or more Associates. The AM owns the client relationship within their pod; the Associate owns campaign execution. You sit above all pods — accountable for what every pod delivers, for the commercial health of the client portfolio, and for the team's growth as professionals.
* This role exists because the team is scaling a significant mandate: taking over client\-facing campaign operations from a CS function, building toward full end\-to\-end ownership of enterprise recruitment advertising accounts. You will be the person who makes that transition work — credible with clients, trusted by your team, and commercially sharp with leadership.
* If you have spent your career executing campaigns for someone else's clients, this is not the right step. If you have owned outcomes — revenue targets, client retention, team results — and are ready to do that in a high\-growth environment, this is the role.



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Own the revenue number for the Social \& Search Operations practice — renewals, upsells, and new business contributions
* Oversee all client pods — review account health across the portfolio, identify risk accounts, and intervene when needed
* Step in as the senior escalation point for client issues that exceed AM\-level resolution
* Present portfolio\-level performance and strategy to senior client stakeholders (C\-suite, VP\-level) on key accounts
* Lead quarterly business reviews for strategic accounts alongside or on behalf of AMs
* Partner with Sales on enterprise pitches and proposals — you bring the performance marketing credibility
* Hire, onboard, and develop AMs and Associates — including defining role clarity, setting performance expectations, and running structured feedback
* Define and enforce operating standards across pods: SLA compliance, reporting quality, campaign health benchmarks
* Work with leadership to define which accounts receive full client\-facing ownership vs. CS\-supported delivery
* Report monthly to senior leadership on capacity utilisation, revenue performance, and team health



  





**What You Will Own** 



* The revenue performance of the Social \& Search Operations practice
* Client retention across all pod accounts — renewal rate, satisfaction, escalation resolution
* Team structure and headcount decisions — you define when a new pod is needed and what profile to hire
* Cross\-pod quality and consistency — every client gets the same standard regardless of which pod they sit in
* The operating model — you update and enforce the RoE, SLAs, and pod protocols as the team evolves



  





**What You Bring** 



* 7–12 years in performance marketing, with the last 3\+ years in a leadership role that included direct revenue or P\&L accountability
* Proven track record of owning client relationships at a senior level — you have presented to and retained enterprise clients, not just supported someone who did
* Direct team management experience — you have hired, developed, and if necessary, exited people
* Deep hands\-on knowledge of paid media (Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, programmatic) — you can review a campaign setup and identify problems, even if you no longer run accounts yourself
* Commercial acumen — you understand margin, renewal economics, upsell signals, and how to have a pricing or scope conversation with a client
* Experience running operations at scale — multiple clients, multiple channels, multiple team members simultaneously
* Strong executive communication — you are credible in a C\-suite room, and you can translate campaign performance into business outcomes without losing the audience
* Bangalore\-based or willing to relocate — this is a full\-time, in\-office leadership role



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Background in performance marketing agencies — multi\-client ops and client servicing discipline is a strong advantage
* Experience in recruitment advertising, employer branding, or HR tech — shortest ramp time into Joveo's client context
* P\&L ownership or revenue target accountability in a previous role — not just budget management
* Experience building or restructuring a team from the ground up
* Exposure to programmatic advertising platforms (DSPs, job boards, Joveo or similar)
* MBA or equivalent from a recognised institution — useful but never a substitute for the track record above



  





**Build the next chapter of Joveo. Apply now**

 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running.  Key job responsibilities
   

  

**About You**
 You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
   

  

 You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging \& complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
   

  

 Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
   

  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co\-located and in\-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting \& managing relationships with external vendors \& contractors
* Liaising with internal teams \& management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health \& Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.


 What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
   

  

 People Management.
   

  

 As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high \& low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
   

  

 Incident Management.
   

  

 You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management \& Fault Management.
   

  

 Vendor Management.
   

  

 An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors \& security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem \& conflict management when dealing with same.
   

  

 Process Improvement.
   

  

 You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process \& a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
   

  

 Health \& Safety.
   

  

 Health \& Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
   

  

**About The Team**
 About AWS
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform.  Inclusive Team Culture

title: Team Lead
description:
**Job Description: Team Lead**




***Department: Talent Acquisition***




***Reports To: Manager / Senior Manager***




***Location: Bangalore or Mysore***




***Employment Type: Full\-Time***




***Mode: Onsite***




  





**Position Summary**




 The Team Lead will own end\-to\-end operations of the Employee Referral program, driving referral volume, quality, and conversion while ensuring accurate and timely referral bonus processing. This role requires a blend of operational discipline, stakeholder management, communication skills, and people leadership to run a high\-performing referral team that supports Infosys BPM hiring needs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**1\. Referral Profile Management** 




 \- Screen and validate employee referral profiles against defined business/role requirements.
 



 \- Ensure timely and accurate submission of validated profiles to recruiters, minimizing turnaround time.
 



**2\. Team \& Workload Management** 




 \- Manage RAP task allocations and calling allocations across the team to optimize productivity.
 



 \- Plan and prioritize daily/weekly workload distribution to maximize candidate outreach and profile conversion.
 



 \- Monitor team performance and provide coaching, feedback, and support to improve output quality.
 



**3\. Campaigns \& Employee Engagement** 




 \- Design and publish recruitment advertisements, mailers, carousel posts, and promotional campaigns to drive referral participation.
 



 \- Plan and execute monthly floor walks, awareness sessions, and engagement programs across business units to boost referral culture.
 



 \- Act as the go\-to point of contact for employees seeking guidance on referral processes, candidate status, policies, and bonus eligibility.
 



**4\. Referral Bonus Processing** 




 \- Manage end\-to\-end Employee Referral Bonus (ERB) processing for both Infosys BPM and Infosys Limited employees.
 



 \- Ensure accuracy of eligibility checks, approvals, and timely disbursement of payouts in line with policy.
 



**5\. Reporting \& Analytics** 




 Prepare, consolidate, and publish key operational reports on a regular cadence, including:
 



 \- Utilization Reports
 



 \- Attendance Reports
 



 \- Client Reports
 



 \- Profile Submission Reports
 



 \- Master Data Reports
 



 \- Floor Walk \& Engagement Activity Reports
 



 \- SLA, TAT \& Productivity Performance Reports
 



**6\. Query Resolution \& SLA Management** 




 \- Resolve employee and stakeholder queries logged via IHD tickets.
 



 \- Ensure all queries are addressed and closed within agreed SLA timelines, maintaining high satisfaction levels.
 



**7\. Communication \& Program Visibility** 




 \- Create, review, and publish internal newsletters showcasing referral achievements, ongoing hiring campaigns, and program updates.
 



 \- Ensure consistent, accurate, and engaging communication to sustain employee interest in the referral program.
 



**8\.Requires Travel** 




**\-** 
 Willingness to travel across Infosys delivery centers in India
 



 \-To conduct floor activities pertaining to employee referrals
 



 \- Target conversion on employee referral across delivery centers
 



  





**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**




 \| KRA \| Measure \|
 



 \| Profile Screening \& Submission \| Turnaround time, submission accuracy \|
 



 \| Team Productivity \| Calling allocation efficiency, RAP task closure rate \|
 



 \| Referral Participation \| Growth in referral volume, campaign engagement \|
 



 \| Bonus Processing \| Payout accuracy, TAT adherence \|
 



 \| SLA Adherence \| IHD ticket closure within SLA \|
 



 \| Reporting \| Timeliness and accuracy of report publishing \|
 



 \| Engagement \| Number/effectiveness of floor walks and awareness sessions \|
 



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies**




 Strong understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment/referral processes.
 



 Excellent team management and workload allocation skills.
 



 Proficiency in MS Excel/PowerPoint for reporting and campaign creation (Canva/design tools a plus).
 



 Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills.
 



 Ability to multitask across operational, financial (bonus processing), and engagement activities.
 



 Analytical mindset with attention to detail, especially for bonus payout accuracy.
 



 Prior experience with ticketing tools (IHD) and SLA\-driven environments preferred.
 



  





**Educational Qualification \& Experience**




 \- Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline (HR specialization preferred).
 



 \- 4 to 7 years of experience in Talent Acquisition/Employee Referral Programs, with at least 1 to 2 years in a team lead or supervisory capacity.
 



  





**Key Interfaces**




 \- Recruiters and Talent Acquisition teams
 



 \- Employees across Infosys BPM and Infosys Limited (referrers)
 



 \- Finance/Payroll teams (for bonus disbursement)
 



 \- Internal communications/branding teams (for campaigns and newsletters)
 



 \- IHD support/ticketing team.

title: Manager – Revenue Operations & Digital Transformation
description:

 **Manager – Revenue Operations \& Business Systems** 
 to drive the transformation and continuous improvement of our Revenue Operations, Zoho ecosystem, automation, and AI capabilities.
   

  

 The role will own the simplification, optimization, and scalability of CRM, Creator and Analytics applications, while identifying opportunities to automate processes, build AI\-powered solutions, and improve the overall technology landscape supporting Revenue Operations.

title: INP066: Sr. Specialist, Supply Chain Operations
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supervisor – Supply Chain Operations (Pharma Vertical in 3PL logistics ) with 10–15 years of experience in supply chain and logistics operations in India, with strong expertise in 3PL, contract logistics and customer\-centric supply chain operations.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience managing complex supply chain operations for Pharma and/or MedTech customers, with a strong understanding of the specific quality, compliance, service and operational requirements associated with these industries.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end supply chain operations, driving operational excellence, improving productivity and service levels, ensuring compliance, managing customer relationships, and delivering sustainable cost and profitability improvements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Supply Chain Operations
* Lead and manage day\-to\-day 3PL / contract logistics operations across assigned customer accounts or locations.
* Ensure smooth and efficient execution of warehousing, inventory, order fulfillment, distribution and transportation activities.
* Translate customer requirements and contractual commitments into effective operational plans.
* Ensure achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, service levels and operational targets.
* Monitor operational performance and take timely corrective actions for gaps and deviations.
* Manage operational capacity in line with business volumes, seasonality and customer growth.
* Ensure business continuity and effective contingency planning.
* Pharma \& MedTech Supply Chain Operations
* Manage supply chain operations for Pharma and MedTech customers, ensuring adherence to customer\-specific requirements and applicable quality standards.
* Develop a strong understanding of Pharma/MedTech supply chain requirements related to product handling, storage, inventory management, order fulfillment, distribution and traceability.
* Ensure compliance with relevant customer quality systems, SOPs and regulatory requirements.
* Work closely with Quality, Compliance and customer teams to manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and operational quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate handling and control of sensitive, high\-value or regulated products as applicable.
* Maintain strong focus on product integrity, inventory accuracy, order accuracy and traceability.
* Customer \& Stakeholder Management
* Act as a key operational point of contact for assigned customers and stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Pharma and MedTech customers.
* Conduct regular operational performance reviews and business reviews with customers.
* Understand customer priorities and proactively address service and operational concerns.
* Manage escalations effectively and ensure timely closure of customer issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and strengthen long\-term partnerships.
* Work closely with Sales, Solution Design, Finance, Procurement, IT, Quality and other internal teams.
* Operational Excellence \& Productivity
* Drive continuous improvement across warehouse, transportation and supply chain processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, resource utilization, process efficiency and service quality.
* Establish and monitor productivity standards for key operational activities.
* Optimize manpower, equipment, warehouse capacity and other operational resources.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive automation, digitization and technology adoption wherever commercially and operationally viable.
* Inventory \& Order Management
* Ensure high levels of inventory accuracy and order fulfillment accuracy.
* Monitor inventory movements, cycle counts, stock reconciliation and inventory controls.
* Ensure timely and accurate order processing, picking, packing and dispatch.
* Monitor inventory variances, damages, losses, expiry and other inventory\-related risks.
* Establish effective controls to minimize errors, rework and operational losses.
* Ensure proper documentation and system transactions across the supply chain process.
* Performance Management \& Analytics
* Define, monitor and improve operational KPIs across customer accounts.
* Track metrics such as:
+ On\-Time In\-Full (OTIF)
+ Order Fulfillment Accuracy
+ Inventory Accuracy
+ Warehouse Productivity
+ Picking/Packing Accuracy
+ Dispatch Accuracy
+ Order Cycle Time
+ Dock\-to\-Stock Time
+ Cost per Order / Unit
+ Space Utilization
+ Manpower Productivity
+ Customer SLA Compliance

* Cost \& Profitability Management
* Manage operating costs for assigned supply chain operations.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction, productivity improvement and margin enhancement.
* Monitor manpower, warehouse, transportation, equipment and other operating costs.
* Ensure operations perform in line with agreed financial and commercial objectives.
* Partner with Finance to monitor budget, actual costs, accruals and profitability.
* Develop and execute action plans to improve account profitability.
* Identify and implement value\-creation opportunities for customers and the business.
* 3PL \& Contract Logistics Management
* Manage and operate complex third\-party logistics and contract logistics environments.
* Ensure adherence to contractual obligations, SLAs, SOPs and commercial commitments.
* Review operational performance against contract requirements.
* Identify contractual gaps, scope changes and opportunities for operational/commercial improvement.
* Support contract renewals, business expansions, transition projects and new customer implementations.
* Ensure effective governance mechanisms are established with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Quality, Compliance \& Risk Management
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer SOPs and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support internal, customer and regulatory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Establish effective operational controls to minimize risks related to inventory, quality, safety and service.
* Promote a strong culture of quality, compliance and operational discipline.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, training and SOP adherence across operations.
* Team Leadership \& People Development
* Lead, develop and mentor operations teams across assigned locations/accounts.
* Establish clear performance objectives and productivity expectations.
* Build a culture of accountability, customer focus and continuous improvement.
* Identify capability gaps and develop training and development plans.
* Manage workforce planning and resource requirements in line with business volumes.
* Develop high\-performing teams and succession pipelines.
* Transformation \& New Business Implementation
* Support new customer onboarding, transition and implementation projects.
* Work with Solution Design and Business Development teams to translate proposed solutions into operational reality.
* Validate operational assumptions, capacity requirements, manpower plans and productivity targets.
* Lead operational readiness activities for new sites, customers, products and services.
* Ensure successful stabilization and handover of new operations to the BAU team.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* MBA in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration or related discipline.
* 10–15 years of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics or operations in India.
* Strong experience in 3PL / third\-party contract logistics.
* Proven experience managing end\-to\-end supply chain or logistics operations.
* Relevant experience working with Pharma and/or MedTech customers within supply chain/logistics operations is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, transportation and distribution.
* Experience managing customer accounts and senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of operational KPIs, SLAs and contract logistics commercial models.
* Experience in productivity improvement, cost optimization and operational excellence.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience with WMS, TMS, ERP/SAP or other supply chain technology platforms is preferred.


**Preferred Industry Experience**
 Candidates from organizations providing
 **3PL / contract logistics services to Pharma, Healthcare, Medical Devices or Life Sciences customers** 
 would be strongly preferred.
   

  

**Experience With The Following Would Be An Advantage**
* Pharma distribution and logistics
* Medical device logistics
* Healthcare supply chains
* Temperature\-controlled / controlled\-condition logistics
* High\-value product handling
* Batch / lot / serial number traceability
* Expiry management
* FEFO / FIFO inventory management
* Regulatory and customer audits
* Reverse logistics
* Product recall / quarantine processes
* Customer\-specific quality and compliance requirements


 The Company
   

  

 FedEx Logistics provides e\-Commerce, freight forwarding, as well as import and export services that allow companies to reach markets throughout the world. They help customers of all sizes solve the intricacies of shipping goods globally by providing comprehensive international ocean and air freight forwarding, surface transportation and distribution, customs brokerage, trade and customs advisory services, and advanced e\-commerce and trade facilitation solutions.
   

  

 The Philosophy
   

  

 People–Service–Profit (P\-S\-P). We take care of our People so that they can deliver impeccable Service to our customers who will give us the Profit necessary for FedEx to be successful. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages employees to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for our employees' well\-being and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 The Culture
   

  

 We honor innovation, integrity and diversity. We have many formal policies, procedures and programs to bring out the best in our staff, individually and in teams.
   

  

 The Mission
   

  

 We strive to be the Best Company to work for with the Best Service and the Best Brand in our industry.
   

  

 We're glad you stopped by and hope your job search experience with FedEx Logistics, Inc. will be rewarding. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Facility Executive- Soft Services
description:
**Senior Soft Services Executive \- Job Description**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The Senior Soft Services Executive is responsible for overseeing and managing the delivery of soft facilities management services across assigned properties or client portfolios. This role ensures high\-quality service delivery, client satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement in soft services operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Service Delivery Management** 
 Oversee day\-to\-day operations of soft services including cleaning, security, landscaping, waste management, pest control, catering, reception, and mailroom services. Ensure all services meet contractual obligations, service level agreements (SLAs), and quality standards. Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits to maintain service excellence.
   

  

**Client Relationship Management** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding soft services matters. Build and maintain strong client relationships through regular meetings, reporting, and proactive communication. Address client concerns promptly and implement corrective actions to ensure satisfaction.
   

  

**Vendor and Contractor Management** 
 Manage relationships with soft services vendors and subcontractors. Monitor vendor performance against KPIs and SLAs. Negotiate contracts, review pricing, and ensure cost\-effective service delivery. Conduct vendor evaluations and implement improvement plans as needed.
   

  

**Financial Management** 
 Develop and manage soft services budgets for assigned properties or portfolios. Monitor expenses, identify cost\-saving opportunities, and ensure services are delivered within budget parameters. Prepare financial reports and forecasts for management review.
   

  

**Team Leadership** 
 Lead, mentor, and develop soft services team members including supervisors and coordinators. Conduct performance reviews, provide training, and foster a culture of accountability and excellence. Coordinate staff scheduling and resource allocation.
   

  

**Compliance and Health \& Safety** 
 Ensure all soft services operations comply with health, safety, environmental regulations, and JLL standards. Maintain compliance documentation and certifications. Conduct risk assessments and implement safety protocols. Coordinate incident reporting and resolution.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement** 
 Identify opportunities for operational improvements and innovation in service delivery. Implement best practices and new technologies to enhance efficiency and quality. Lead process improvement initiatives and track results.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
**Experience** 
 5\-8 years of experience in facilities management with significant focus on soft services. Proven track record managing multiple sites or large\-scale facilities. Experience in vendor management and contract administration.
   

  

**Education** 
 Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred. Professional certifications (IFMA, RICS, or equivalent) are advantageous.
   

  

**Skills and Competencies** 
 Strong leadership and people management capabilities. Excellent client service orientation and communication skills. Financial acumen with budget management experience. Problem\-solving ability and attention to detail. Proficiency in FM software and Microsoft Office Suite. Understanding of health and safety regulations and compliance requirements.
   

  

**Personal Attributes** 
 Professional demeanor with ability to interact with senior stakeholders. Proactive and results\-oriented approach. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. Strong organizational and time management skills.
   

  

 Working Conditions
   

  

 This role typically requires site\-based presence .
